;;; $8000..A0F8: Map16 tile definitions (8 bytes per tile) ;;;
;; Map16 16x16 block definitions, 8 bytes each: four (8x8 character, property) pairs in the order top-left,
;;     bottom-left,
;; top-right, bottom-right. Property byte is YXPCCCTT (Y/X flip, priority, palette, GFX page).
;; The level loader (bank 05, via the bit mask at $05:81BB) copies the shared tiles from here and picks the
;;     tileset-specific
;; part from $0D8B70/$0DBC00/$0DC800/$0DD400/$0DE300 (TilesetMAP16Loc). So a row's Map16 number is not simply
;;     (addr-$8000)/8.
;; Each row below is decoded as chr/prop for the four quarters. $0DA0A0-$0DA0F8 is $FF padding.
$0D:8000              .db $70,$1C,$72,$1C,$71,$1C,$73,$1C ; TL $70/$1C BL $72/$1C TR $71/$1C BR $73/$1C
$0D:8008              .db $C5,$09,$FB,$08,$C5,$09,$FB,$08 ; TL $C5/$09 BL $FB/$08 TR $C5/$09 BR $FB/$08
$0D:8010              .db $FD,$1C,$FD,$1C,$FD,$1C,$FD,$1C ; TL $FD/$1C BL $FD/$1C TR $FD/$1C BR $FD/$1C
$0D:8018              .db $FB,$08,$FB,$08,$FB,$08,$FB,$08 ; TL $FB/$08 BL $FB/$08 TR $FB/$08 BR $FB/$08
$0D:8020              .db $4C,$2C,$4E,$2C,$4D,$2C,$4F,$2C ; TL $4C/$2C BL $4E/$2C TR $4D/$2C BR $4F/$2C
$0D:8028              .db $FC,$2C,$FC,$2C,$FC,$2C,$FC,$2C ; TL $FC/$2C BL $FC/$2C TR $FC/$2C BR $FC/$2C
$0D:8030              .db $87,$14,$88,$54,$88,$14,$87,$54 ; TL $87/$14 BL $88/$54 TR $88/$14 BR $87/$54

;;; $A100: Load extended object ;;;
;; Entry point (JSL) for extended level objects. Takes the extended object number in [$59] as index into the
;;     pointer table at $0DA10F.
;; Parameters: [$59]: extended object number. Quirk: redundant SEP #$30 and a JSR wrapper around a JSL
;;     dispatch.
;; Called by:
;;     $05:86E5: Load extended object (LevLoadExtObj)
$0D:A100 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; 8-bit A/X/Y
$0D:A102 20 06 A1     JSR.W $A106                     ; Run the extended object code
$0D:A105 6B           RTL                             ; Return to the level loader

$0D:A106 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; 8-bit A/X/Y again
$0D:A108 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; A = extended object number
$0D:A10A AA           TAX                             ; X = extended object number
$0D:A10B 22 FA 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtrLong            ; Jump through the pointer table at $0DA10F, indexed by [X]


;;; $A10F: Extended object $00 pointer: Screen exit (PtrsLong0DA10F) ;;;
;; First of 3-byte (16-bit address + bank) pointers indexed by the extended object number [$59] ($00-$FF).
;; Used by ExtendedObjectLoader at $0DA10B through ExecutePtrLong. Entries $02-$10 are unused nulls.
$0D:A10F 12 A5 0D     .dw $A512 .db :$CODE_0DA512     ; $59=$00: Screen exit -> $A512

;;; $A112: Extended object $01 pointer: Screen jump (PtrsLong0DA112) ;;;

;; Last standard object pointer (bushes 1 through 5), followed by the two extended object routines at index
;;     $00 and $01.
;; Screen exit ($A512): reads the destination screen byte from the level data, stores it in $19B8,X (X =
;;     screen), water flag in $19D8,X,
;; and the secondary-exit flag in $1B93. Screen jump ($A53D): sets the current screen number
;;     [$1928]/[$1BA1] from the object's screen.
$0D:A50F B7 B5 0D     .dw $B5B7 .db :$CODE_0DB5B7     ; $5A=$3F: Bushes 1 through 5 -> $B5B7

;This is the screen exit routine.
$0D:A512 A0 00        LDY.B #$00                      ; Y = 0
$0D:A514 B7 65        LDA [$65],Y                     ; A = destination screen byte from the level data
$0D:A516 85 5A        STA $5A                         ; [$5A] = destination screen
$0D:A518 C8           INY                             ; Y = 1
$0D:A519 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:A51A 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:A51B 65 65        ADC $65                         ; |
$0D:A51D 85 65        STA $65                         ; |
$0D:A51F A5 66        LDA $66                         ; |
$0D:A521 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$0D:A523 85 66        STA $66                         ; } Advance the level data pointer [$65] by one byte
$0D:A525 A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$0D:A527 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; |
$0D:A529 AA           TAX                             ; } X = screen number of the object ([$0A] & $1F)
$0D:A52A A5 5A        LDA $5A                         ; \
$0D:A52C 9D B8 19     STA.W $19B8,X                   ; } Destination screen -> $19B8,X
$0D:A52F A5 0B        LDA $0B                         ; \
$0D:A531 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; |
$0D:A533 9D D8 19     STA.W $19D8,X                   ; } Water flag (bit 0 of [$0B]) -> $19D8,X (only used here)
$0D:A536 A5 0B        LDA $0B                         ; \
$0D:A538 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:A539 8D 93 1B     STA.W $1B93                     ; } Secondary exit flag -> [$1B93]
$0D:A53C 60           RTS                             ; Return
;Compressed version of the above routine:
;LDA $0A : AND #$1F : TAX : LDA [$65] : STA $19B8,x : REP #$20 : INC $65 : SEP #$20 : LDA $0B : STA $1B93 : RTS


;This is the screen jump routine. It's so short that I fail to see any reason to add any more comments to it (except to flame the coders).
$0D:A53D A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$0D:A53F 29 1F        AND.B #$1F                      ; |
$0D:A541 8D 28 19     STA.W $1928                     ; } Current screen number [$1928] = object screen ([$0A] & $1F)
$0D:A544 8D A1 1B     STA.W $1BA1                     ; Also [$1BA1] = screen number
$0D:A547 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This code handles many single-tile objects.

;;; $A548..A578: Table: Map16 tile numbers for single-tile objects ;;;
;; Indexed by extended object number minus $10. Gives the Map16 tile (low byte) written by $A57B.
;; Indexes from $13 up use the high Map16 page ($100+).
$0D:A548              .db $1F,$22,$24,$42,$43,$27,$29,$25 ; Tiles for ext objects $10-$17
$0D:A550              .db $6E,$6F,$70,$71,$72,$45,$46,$47 ; Tiles for ext objects $18-$1F
$0D:A558              .db $48,$36,$37,$11,$12,$14,$15,$16 ; Tiles for ext objects $20-$27
$0D:A560              .db $17,$18,$19,$1A,$1B,$1C,$29,$1D ; Tiles for ext objects $28-$2F
$0D:A568              .db $1F,$20,$21,$22,$23,$25,$26,$27 ; Tiles for ext objects $30-$37
$0D:A570              .db $28,$2A,$DE,$E0,$E2,$E4,$EC,$ED ; Tiles for ext objects $38-$3F
$0D:A578              .db $2C,$25,$2D                 ; Tiles for ext objects $40-$42


;;; $A57B: Draw single-tile extended objects ;;;
;; Writes one Map16 tile for extended objects $10 and up (doors, invisible blocks, berries, turn blocks, ?
;;     blocks, corner edges, ...).
;; Skips the invisible 1UP and 3-UP moon if already collected in this level, and replaces item-memory objects
;;     that were already hit by a used block.
;; Parameters: X: extended object number; Y/[$57]: tile position in the level buffer. Writes through [$6B],Y.
;; $A64D: generates the green star block by entering the middle of the routine with index $32.
$0D:A57B 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:A57C 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:A57D E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; } A = ext object number - $10
$0D:A57F 85 00        STA $00                         ; [$00] = tile table index (also used for item memory checks)
$0D:A581 E0 18        CPX.B #$18                      ; \
$0D:A583 90 2C        BCC $A5B1                       ; / Index $18-$1C are the invisible 1UP and moon objects, which check collected flags first
$0D:A585 E0 1D        CPX.B #$1D                      ; \
$0D:A587 B0 28        BCS $A5B1                       ; / Otherwise skip the collected check
$0D:A589 AD BF 13     LDA.W $13BF                     ; \
$0D:A58C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:A58D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:A58E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:A58F A8           TAY                             ; } Y = [$13BF] / 8 (byte index of the level in the collected-flag tables)
$0D:A590 AD BF 13     LDA.W $13BF                     ; \
$0D:A593 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$0D:A595 AA           TAX                             ; } X = [$13BF] & 7 (bit index)
$0D:A596 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:A598 C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; / Index 8 = 3-UP moon uses a different flag table
$0D:A59A D0 0B        BNE $A5A7                       ; (not the moon)
$0D:A59C B9 EE 1F     LDA.W $1FEE,Y                   ; \
$0D:A59F 3F A6 A8 0D  AND.L $A8A6,X                   ; |
$0D:A5A3 F0 0C        BEQ $A5B1                       ; } Moon: test its collected bit in $1FEE,Y; if clear draw it
$0D:A5A5 80 09        BRA $A5B0                       ; Already collected: draw nothing

$0D:A5A7 B9 3C 1F     LDA.W $1F3C,Y                   ; \
$0D:A5AA 3F A6 A8 0D  AND.L $A8A6,X                   ; |
$0D:A5AE F0 01        BEQ $A5B1                       ; } Invisible 1UP: test its collected bit in $1F3C,Y; if clear draw it
$0D:A5B0 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0D:A5B1 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = tile position [$57]
$0D:A5B3 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:A5B6 A6 00        LDX $00                         ; |
$0D:A5B8 E0 13        CPX.B #$13                      ; |
$0D:A5BA 30 03        BMI $A5BF                       ; |
$0D:A5BC 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; } Select Map16 page: tile index $13+ lives on page 1 (tile $100+), else page 0
$0D:A5BF BF 48 A5 0D  LDA.L $A548,X                   ; A = Map16 tile for this object
$0D:A5C3 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; [$0C] = tile to write
$0D:A5C5 E0 01        CPX.B #$01                      ; \
$0D:A5C7 F0 27        BEQ $A5F0                       ; |
$0D:A5C9 E0 07        CPX.B #$07                      ; |
$0D:A5CB F0 23        BEQ $A5F0                       ; |
$0D:A5CD E0 32        CPX.B #$32                      ; |
$0D:A5CF F0 1F        BEQ $A5F0                       ; |
$0D:A5D1 E0 26        CPX.B #$26                      ; |
$0D:A5D3 F0 1B        BEQ $A5F0                       ; |
$0D:A5D5 E0 1B        CPX.B #$1B                      ; |
$0D:A5D7 D0 6F        BNE $A648                       ; } Objects $01, $07, $32, $26, $1B use item memory; others just draw ($A648)
$0D:A5D9 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:A5DA 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:A5DC C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$0D:A5DE F0 10        BEQ $A5F0                       ; |
$0D:A5E0 C9 04        CMP.B #$04                      ; |
$0D:A5E2 F0 0C        BEQ $A5F0                       ; |
$0D:A5E4 C9 07        CMP.B #$07                      ; |
$0D:A5E6 F0 08        BEQ $A5F0                       ; |
$0D:A5E8 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; |
$0D:A5EA F0 04        BEQ $A5F0                       ; |
$0D:A5EC C9 0D        CMP.B #$0D                      ; |
$0D:A5EE D0 58        BNE $A648                       ; } Object $1B only checks item memory when X position & $F is 1, 4, 7, $A or $D
$0D:A5F0 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:A5F1 48           PHA                             ; |
$0D:A5F2 98           TYA                             ; |
$0D:A5F3 48           PHA                             ; } Preserve X and Y on the stack
$0D:A5F4 AE BE 13     LDX.W $13BE                     ; X = [$13BE] (index of the item memory table for this level)
$0D:A5F7 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; \
$0D:A5F9 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:A5FA 7F AE A8 0D  ADC.L $A8AE,X                   ; |
$0D:A5FE 85 08        STA $08                         ; } [$08] = low byte of item memory pointer, $19F8 + table offset
$0D:A600 A9 19        LDA.B #$19                      ; \
$0D:A602 7F B1 A8 0D  ADC.L $A8B1,X                   ; |
$0D:A606 85 09        STA $09                         ; } [$09] = high byte of item memory pointer
$0D:A608 AD A1 1B     LDA.W $1BA1                     ; \
$0D:A60B 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0D:A60C 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0D:A60D 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; } [$0E] = current screen number * 4
$0D:A60F A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$0D:A611 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; |
$0D:A613 F0 06        BEQ $A61B                       ; |
$0D:A615 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; |
$0D:A617 09 02        ORA.B #$02                      ; |
$0D:A619 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; } If the object is in the lower half (Y bit 4 of [$0A]), [$0E] |= 2
$0D:A61B 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:A61C 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$0D:A61E F0 06        BEQ $A626                       ; |
$0D:A620 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; |
$0D:A622 09 01        ORA.B #$01                      ; |
$0D:A624 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; } If the X column is >= 8, [$0E] |= 1
$0D:A626 A5 57        LDA $57                         ; \
$0D:A628 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$0D:A62A AA           TAX                             ; } X = [$57] & 7 (bit within the byte)
$0D:A62B A4 0E        LDY $0E                         ; \
$0D:A62D B1 08        LDA ($08),Y                     ; |
$0D:A62F 3F A6 A8 0D  AND.L $A8A6,X                   ; |
$0D:A633 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; } [$0F] = item memory byte ([$08]),Y masked with bit X
$0D:A635 68           PLA                             ; \
$0D:A636 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:A637 68           PLA                             ; |
$0D:A638 AA           TAX                             ; } Restore X and Y
$0D:A639 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$0D:A63B F0 0B        BEQ $A648                       ; / Bit clear (never hit): draw the original tile
$0D:A63D E0 07        CPX.B #$07                      ; \
$0D:A63F F0 0B        BEQ $A64C                       ; / Index $07 (green star block): leave it empty, no used block
$0D:A641 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:A644 A9 32        LDA.B #$32                      ; |
$0D:A646 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; } Replace with tile $32 on page 1 (brown used block)
$0D:A648 A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; A = tile to write
$0D:A64A 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; Write it to the level buffer at [$6B],Y
$0D:A64C 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This tiny code generates the green star block.
$0D:A64D A9 32        LDA.B #$32                      ; Pretend the object index is $32 (green star block)
$0D:A64F 4C 7F A5     JMP.W $A57F                     ; Enter the middle of the single-tile routine


;This is the code for the small slopes (no idea what they're good for).

;;; $A652..A654: Table: small slope tiles ;;;
$0D:A652              .db $D8,$DB                     ; Left slope tiles (object $42, $43)

$0D:A654              .db $DA,$DC                     ; Right slope tiles (object $42, $43)


;;; $A656: Draw small slopes (unused objects) ;;;
;; Draws a two-tile-wide small slope for extended objects $42/$43: left tile then right tile.
;; Parameters: X: extended object number ($42 or $43); Y/[$57]: position.
$0D:A656 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = tile position [$57]
$0D:A658 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:A659 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:A65A E9 42        SBC.B #$42                      ; |
$0D:A65C AA           TAX                             ; } X = ext object number - $42
$0D:A65D 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Select page 1 of the Map16 buffer
$0D:A660 BF 52 A6 0D  LDA.L $A652,X                   ; \
$0D:A664 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; } A = left tile; write it and step one column right
$0D:A667 BF 54 A6 0D  LDA.L $A654,X                   ; \
$0D:A66B 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; } Write the right tile
$0D:A66D 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Select page 1
$0D:A670 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This is the code for the triangles.

;;; $A671..A671: Table: purple triangle top tiles ;;;
$0D:A671              .db $B4,$B5                     ; Triangle top tiles (object $44, $45)


;;; $A673: Draw triangles, midway point and pointer helpers ;;;
;; Purple triangle (extended objects $44/$45): top tile from table, bottom tile always $EB.
;; Midway point ($A68E): draws the midway rope tiles unless the midway flag is already set.
;; $A6B1/$A6BA: save and restore the level data pointer ($6B/$6C -> $04/$05) and the current
;;     screen number.
$0D:A673 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = tile position [$57]
$0D:A675 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:A676 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:A677 E9 44        SBC.B #$44                      ; |
$0D:A679 AA           TAX                             ; } X = ext object number - $44
$0D:A67A BF 71 A6 0D  LDA.L $A671,X                   ; \
$0D:A67E 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; } Write the top tile
$0D:A680 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Select page 1
$0D:A683 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Step one row down
$0D:A686 A9 EB        LDA.B #$EB                      ; \
$0D:A688 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; } Write bottom tile $EB
$0D:A68A 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Select page 1
$0D:A68D 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This is the code for the midway point.
$0D:A68E AE BF 13     LDX.W $13BF                     ; \
$0D:A691 BF A2 1E 00  LDA.L $001EA2,X                 ; |
$0D:A695 29 40        AND.B #$40                      ; |
$0D:A697 D0 17        BNE $A6B0                       ; / Midway flag for this level already set: draw nothing
$0D:A699 AD CE 13     LDA.W $13CE                     ; \
$0D:A69C D0 12        BNE $A6B0                       ; / Second midway flag [$13CE] set: draw nothing
$0D:A69E A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position
$0D:A6A0 88           DEY                             ; One column left of the object
$0D:A6A1 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; Select page 0
$0D:A6A4 A9 35        LDA.B #$35                      ; Left tile $35
$0D:A6A6 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; Write it and step right
$0D:A6A9 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; Select page 0
$0D:A6AC A9 38        LDA.B #$38                      ; Right tile $38
$0D:A6AE 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; Write it
$0D:A6B0 60           RTS                             ; Return

;Preserve data pointer
$0D:A6B1 A5 6B        LDA $6B                         ; \
$0D:A6B3 85 04        STA $04                         ; |
$0D:A6B5 A5 6C        LDA $6C                         ; |
$0D:A6B7 85 05        STA $05                         ; } Save the level buffer pointer [$6B] in [$04]
$0D:A6B9 60           RTS                             ; Return

;Reload data pointer
$0D:A6BA A5 04        LDA $04                         ; \
$0D:A6BC 85 6B        STA $6B                         ; |
$0D:A6BE 85 6E        STA $6E                         ; |
$0D:A6C0 A5 05        LDA $05                         ; |
$0D:A6C2 85 6C        STA $6C                         ; |
$0D:A6C4 85 6F        STA $6F                         ; } Restore [$6B]/[$6E] from the saved pointer in [$04]
$0D:A6C6 AD 28 19     LDA.W $1928                     ; \
$0D:A6C9 8D A1 1B     STA.W $1BA1                     ; } Restore current screen [$1BA1] from [$1928]
$0D:A6CC 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This is the code for the two-tiles-high tile doors (and the unused $98-$FF, which will generate garbage)

;;; $A6CD..A6CF: Table: door tiles ;;;
$0D:A6CD              .db $1F,$27                     ; Door top tiles (object $47+)

$0D:A6CF              .db $20,$28                     ; Door bottom tiles (object $47+)


;;; $A6D1: Draw two-tile-high door ;;;
;; Extended objects $47 and up: writes a top tile and, one row below, a bottom tile from the tables at
;;     $0DA6CD/$0DA6CF.
;; Also reached by the unused objects $98-$FF, which index past the table and draw garbage.
$0D:A6D1 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = tile position [$57]
$0D:A6D3 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:A6D4 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:A6D5 E9 47        SBC.B #$47                      ; |
$0D:A6D7 AA           TAX                             ; } X = ext object number - $47
$0D:A6D8 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; Select page 0
$0D:A6DB BF CD A6 0D  LDA.L $A6CD,X                   ; \
$0D:A6DF 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; } Write the top tile
$0D:A6E1 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Step one row down
$0D:A6E4 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; Select page 0
$0D:A6E7 BF CF A6 0D  LDA.L $A6CF,X                   ; \
$0D:A6EB 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; } Write the bottom tile
$0D:A6ED 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This is the code for the big bush.
;I know that this table uses nine bytes/row instead of eight, but it's much more readable that way.

;;; $A6EE..A712: Table: big bush 1 Map16 tiles (9 bytes per row) ;;;
$0D:A6EE              .db $25,$25,$25,$4B,$4D,$4E,$25,$25,$25 ; Big bush 1 row 0 (9 tiles, $25 = sky/background)
$0D:A6F7              .db $25,$25,$54,$49,$49,$5F,$63,$25,$25 ; Big bush 1 row 1 (9 tiles, $25 = sky/background)
$0D:A700              .db $25,$25,$57,$49,$49,$52,$4A,$5D,$25 ; Big bush 1 row 2 (9 tiles, $25 = sky/background)
$0D:A709              .db $25,$5A,$49,$49,$50,$51,$4A,$60,$25 ; Big bush 1 row 3 (9 tiles, $25 = sky/background)
$0D:A712              .db $5A,$49,$49,$49,$53,$4A,$4A,$4A,$63 ; Big bush 1 row 4 (9 tiles, $25 = sky/background)


;;; $A71B: Object: big bush ;;;
;; Draws a 9x5 bush into the Map16 map from table $A6EE (blank $25 is skipped).
;; Uses the bush tile adder at $0DA78D so tiles blend with an existing bush.
$0D:A71B A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57]: position of the object (low nibble X, high nibble Y in the screen)
$0D:A71D A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$0D:A71F 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = 8: width - 1 (9 columns)
$0D:A721 A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$0D:A723 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = 4: height - 1 (5 rows)
$0D:A725 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into the bush tile table
$0D:A727 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the Map16 pointer [$6B]-[$6C] to [$04]-[$05] (start of row)
$0D:A72A A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:A72C 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = columns left in this row
$0D:A72E 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:A731 BF EE A6 0D  LDA.L $A6EE,X                   ; |
$0D:A735 20 8D A7     JSR.W $A78D                     ; } Write bush tile [DATA_0DA6EE+X] to the Map16 map (page 0), then X++
$0D:A738 E8           INX                             ; /
$0D:A739 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; Columns left in the row: $02--
$0D:A73B 10 F1        BPL $A72E                       ; Loop until the row is done
$0D:A73D 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; \
$0D:A740 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; / Reload the row start pointer and move down one row
$0D:A743 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; Rows left: $01--
$0D:A745 10 E3        BPL $A72A                       ; Loop until all rows are drawn
$0D:A747 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This is the code for the small bush.
;(yes, weird table width again)

;;; $A748..A75A: Map16 tiles: small bush ;;;
;; 6 tiles per row, 4 rows. $25 = blank (not drawn).
$0D:A748              .db $25,$25,$4B,$4C,$25,$25     ; Row 0: -, -, $4B, $4C, -, - ($25 = blank, not drawn)
$0D:A74E              .db $25,$54,$49,$5F,$63,$25     ; Row 1: -, $54, $49, $5F, $63, -
$0D:A754              .db $25,$57,$49,$52,$4A,$5D     ; Row 2: -, $57, $49, $52, $4A, $5D
$0D:A75A              .db $5A,$49,$49,$49,$4F,$60     ; Row 3: $5A, $49, $49, $49, $4F, $60


;;; $A760: Object: small bush and bush tile adder ;;;
;; Draws a 6x4 bush from $A748. Tile adder at $0DA78D: blank $25 is skipped; tiles >= $54 are bumped by
;;     1 or 2 when drawn over an existing bush tile.
;; Parameters: Y: [$57] map position.
$0D:A760 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; \
$0D:A762 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; / Y = [$57] position; $00 = 5: width - 1 (6 columns)
$0D:A764 85 00        STA $00                         ; \
$0D:A766 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; / $01 = 3: height - 1 (4 rows)
$0D:A768 85 01        STA $01
$0D:A76A A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into the small bush tile table
$0D:A76C 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the Map16 pointer to [$04]-[$05]
$0D:A76F A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:A771 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = columns left in this row
$0D:A773 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:A776 BF 48 A7 0D  LDA.L $A748,X                   ; |
$0D:A77A 20 8D A7     JSR.W $A78D                     ; } Add bush tile [DATA_0DA748+X] at the current position (page 0), X++
$0D:A77D E8           INX                             ; /
$0D:A77E C6 02        DEC $02                         ; Columns left: $02--
$0D:A780 10 F1        BPL $A773                       ; Loop until the row is done
$0D:A782 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; \
$0D:A785 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; / Reload the row start pointer and move down one row
$0D:A788 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; Rows left: $01--
$0D:A78A 10 E3        BPL $A76F                       ; Loop until all rows are drawn
$0D:A78C 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This code adds a tile for the bush.
$0D:A78D 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; $0F = tile to write
$0D:A78F C9 25        CMP.B #$25                      ; \
$0D:A791 D0 03        BNE $A796                       ; / Blank tile $25?
$0D:A793 4C 5D A9     JMP.W $A95D                     ; Yes: skip it, just advance the position (keep what is underneath)

$0D:A796 C9 49        CMP.B #$49                      ; \
$0D:A798 90 12        BCC $A7AC                       ; / Tile < $49: write it unchanged
$0D:A79A C9 54        CMP.B #$54                      ; \
$0D:A79C 90 0E        BCC $A7AC                       ; / Tile in $49-$53 (single-color fill): write unchanged
$0D:A79E B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; Look at the tile already in the map at this position
$0D:A7A0 C9 25        CMP.B #$25                      ; \
$0D:A7A2 F0 08        BEQ $A7AC                       ; / Existing tile blank ($25)? Then write the new tile unchanged
$0D:A7A4 C9 49        CMP.B #$49                      ; \
$0D:A7A6 F0 02        BEQ $A7AA                       ; / Existing tile $49 (the plain bright fill)? Then add only 1
$0D:A7A8 E6 0F        INC $0F                         ; Otherwise add 2 (variant of the tile that blends with the bush underneath)
$0D:A7AA E6 0F        INC $0F                         ; $0F += 1 (or 2 if it came through A7A8)
$0D:A7AC A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$0D:A7AE 4C 5B A9     JMP.W $A95B                     ; / A = adjusted bush tile; write it and advance one tile right


;This is the code for the net door.
;(yes I'm stubborn with that table width thingy)

;;; $A7B1..A7BD: Map16 tiles: net door ;;;
;; 4 columns x 4 rows.
$0D:A7B1              .db $10,$11,$11,$12             ; Row 0: $10, $11, $11, $12
$0D:A7B5              .db $13,$0B,$0B,$15             ; Row 1: $13, $0B, $0B, $15
$0D:A7B9              .db $13,$0B,$0B,$15             ; Row 2: $13, $0B, $0B, $15
$0D:A7BD              .db $16,$17,$17,$18             ; Row 3: $16, $17, $17, $18


;;; $A7C1: Object: net door ;;;
;; Draws the 4x4 climbing net door from $A7B1.
$0D:A7C1 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] position of the object
$0D:A7C3 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: tile table index
$0D:A7C5 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the Map16 pointer to [$04]-[$05]
$0D:A7C8 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$0D:A7CA 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = 3: tiles per row - 1 (4 columns)
$0D:A7CC BF B1 A7 0D  LDA.L $A7B1,X                   ; \
$0D:A7D0 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Add tile [DATA_0DA7B1+X] and advance one tile right
$0D:A7D3 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:A7D4 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; / X++, columns left: $02--
$0D:A7D6 10 F4        BPL $A7CC                       ; Loop until the row is done
$0D:A7D8 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; \
$0D:A7DB 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; / Reload the row start pointer and move down one row
$0D:A7DE E0 10        CPX.B #$10                      ; All 16 tiles drawn?
$0D:A7E0 D0 E6        BNE $A7C8                       ; No: next row
$0D:A7E2 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Goal sign

;;; $A7E3..A7E5: Map16 tiles: goal sign ;;;
;; 2x2: $66 $67 / $68 $69.
$0D:A7E3              .db $66,$67                     ; Top row: $66, $67
$0D:A7E5              .db $68,$69                     ; Bottom row: $68, $69


;;; $A7E7: Object: goal sign ;;;
;; Draws the 2x2 goal sign from $A7E3 (page 0).
$0D:A7E7 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] position of the object
$0D:A7E9 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: tile table index
$0D:A7EB 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the Map16 pointer to [$04]-[$05]
$0D:A7EE 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; Set the Map16 high byte to 0 (page 0)
$0D:A7F1 BF E3 A7 0D  LDA.L $A7E3,X                   ; \
$0D:A7F5 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Add tile [DATA_0DA7E3+X] and advance one tile right
$0D:A7F8 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:A7F9 8A           TXA                             ; } X++; A = X AND 1: 0 after every second tile (width 2)
$0D:A7FA 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; /
$0D:A7FC D0 F0        BNE $A7EE                       ; Row not finished yet: next tile
$0D:A7FE 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; \
$0D:A801 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; / Reload the row start pointer and move down one row
$0D:A804 E0 04        CPX.B #$04                      ; All 4 tiles drawn?
$0D:A806 D0 E6        BNE $A7EE                       ; No: next row
$0D:A808 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Steep vertical-level-compatible slopes

;;; $A809..A80B: Map16 tiles: steep slopes (vertical level) ;;;
;; Top tiles $AA/$AF, bottom tiles $E2/$E4 for objects $91/$92.
$0D:A809              .db $AA,$AF                     ; Top tiles: object $91 = $AA, object $92 = $AF

$0D:A80B              .db $E2,$E4                     ; Bottom tiles: object $91 = $E2, object $92 = $E4


;;; $A80D: Object: steep slope, vertical-level safe ;;;
;; Two tiles high (page 1). Object number $91/$92 selects left/right.
;; Also contains $A82A: move position down one row, updating the pointer high byte by 2 on carry.
$0D:A80D A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] position of the object
$0D:A80F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:A810 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:A811 E9 91        SBC.B #$91                      ; } X = object number - $91 (0 or 1)
$0D:A813 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:A814 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:A817 BF 09 A8 0D  LDA.L $A809,X                   ; } Set page 1 and store top tile [DATA_0DA809+X] ($1xx)
$0D:A81B 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:A81D 20 2A A8     JSR.W $A82A                     ; Move the position down one row (vertical-level safe)
$0D:A820 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:A823 BF 0B A8 0D  LDA.L $A80B,X                   ; } Set page 1 and store bottom tile [DATA_0DA80B+X]
$0D:A827 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:A829 60           RTS                             ; Return

;This moves the pointer downwards without breaking in vertical level boundaries.
$0D:A82A A5 57        LDA $57                         ; \
$0D:A82C 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:A82D 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } $57 += $10: move the position down one row
$0D:A82F 85 57        STA $57                         ; /
$0D:A831 A8           TAY                             ; \
$0D:A832 90 09        BCC $A83D                       ; / Y = new position; no carry means still inside the same block
$0D:A834 A5 6C        LDA $6C                         ; \
$0D:A836 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:A837 69 02        ADC.B #$02                      ; } Carry: Map16 pointer high byte [$6C] += 2 (next block in a vertical level)
$0D:A839 85 6C        STA $6C                         ; /
$0D:A83B 85 6F        STA $6F                         ; Mirror the new high byte into [$6F]
$0D:A83D 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Normal vertical-level-compatible slopes (will break at horizontal boundaries, though)

;;; $A83E..A844: Map16 tiles: normal slopes (vertical level) ;;;
;; Top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right tiles for objects $93/$94.
$0D:A83E              .db $96,$A0                     ; Top-left tiles: object $93 = $96, object $94 = $A0

$0D:A840              .db $9B,$A5                     ; Top-right tiles: object $93 = $9B, object $94 = $A5

$0D:A842              .db $DE,$E6                     ; Bottom-left tiles: object $93 = $DE, object $94 = $E6

$0D:A844              .db $E6,$E0                     ; Bottom-right tiles: object $93 = $E6, object $94 = $E0


;;; $A846: Object: normal slope, vertical-level safe ;;;
;; 2x2 slope (page 1). Object number $93/$94 selects left/right.
$0D:A846 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] position of the object
$0D:A848 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:A849 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:A84A E9 93        SBC.B #$93                      ; } X = object number - $93 (0 or 1)
$0D:A84C AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:A84D 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:A850 BF 3E A8 0D  LDA.L $A83E,X                   ; } Set page 1, add top-left tile [DATA_0DA83E+X], advance right
$0D:A854 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:A857 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:A85A BF 40 A8 0D  LDA.L $A840,X                   ; } Set page 1, store top-right tile [DATA_0DA840+X]
$0D:A85E 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:A860 20 2A A8     JSR.W $A82A                     ; Move the position down one row (also back to the left column)
$0D:A863 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:A866 BF 42 A8 0D  LDA.L $A842,X                   ; } Set page 1, add bottom-left tile [DATA_0DA842+X], advance right
$0D:A86A 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:A86D 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:A870 BF 44 A8 0D  LDA.L $A844,X                   ; } Set page 1, store bottom-right tile [DATA_0DA844+X]
$0D:A874 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:A876 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This is the code for the very steep slopes (vertical level compatible).

;;; $A877..A87B: Map16 tiles: very steep slopes ;;;
;; Top $CA/$CC, middle $CB/$CD, bottom $F1/$F2 for objects $95/$96.
$0D:A877              .db $CA,$CC                     ; Top tiles: object $95 = $CA, object $96 = $CC

$0D:A879              .db $CB,$CD                     ; Middle tiles: object $95 = $CB, object $96 = $CD

$0D:A87B              .db $F1,$F2                     ; Bottom tiles: object $95 = $F1, object $96 = $F2


;;; $A87D: Object: very steep slope, vertical-level safe ;;;
;; One column, three rows (page 1). Object number $95/$96 selects left/right.
$0D:A87D A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] position of the object
$0D:A87F 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:A880 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:A881 E9 95        SBC.B #$95                      ; } X = object number - $95 (0 or 1)
$0D:A883 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:A884 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:A887 BF 77 A8 0D  LDA.L $A877,X                   ; } Set page 1, store top tile [DATA_0DA877+X]
$0D:A88B 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:A88D 20 2A A8     JSR.W $A82A                     ; Move the position down one row
$0D:A890 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:A893 BF 79 A8 0D  LDA.L $A879,X                   ; } Set page 1, store middle tile [DATA_0DA879+X]
$0D:A897 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:A899 20 2A A8     JSR.W $A82A                     ; Move the position down one row
$0D:A89C 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:A89F BF 7B A8 0D  LDA.L $A87B,X                   ; } Set page 1, store bottom tile [DATA_0DA87B+X]
$0D:A8A3 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:A8A5 60           RTS                             ; Return



;;; $A8A6..A8BC: Data: bit masks and rectangle object tables ;;;
;; Bit masks $80-$01; item memory table offsets for coins (low/high bytes); Map16 tile per rectangle object ID
;;     (X).
$0D:A8A6              .db $80,$40,$20,$10,$08,$04,$02,$01 ; Bit masks $80 down to $01 (bit for column 0-7)
;This code handles many objects.
$0D:A8AE              .db $00,$80,$00                 ; Item memory table offset, low byte, per item memory setting [$13BE]: $00, $80, $00

$0D:A8B1              .db $00,$00,$01                 ; Item memory table offset, high byte: $00, $00, $01 (offsets $000, $080, $100)

$0D:A8B4              .db $02,$21,$23,$2A,$2B,$3F,$03,$13 ; Map16 tile per object ID (X): $02, $21, $23, $2A, $2B (coin), $3F, $03; page 1 from X=7: $113
$0D:A8BC              .db $1E,$24,$2E,$2F,$30,$32,$65 ; Map16 tiles (page 1) for X = 8-14: $11E, $124, $12E, $12F, $130, $132, $165


;;; $A8C3: Rectangle objects and Map16 pointer helpers ;;;
;; Fills a width x height rectangle with the Map16 tile for the object ID in X. Size in [$59]: low nibble
;;     width - 1, high nibble height - 1.
;; Coins (X = 4) first check item memory ($19F8+) and are skipped if already collected.
;; Followed by helpers: $0DA95B add tile and move right, $0DA97D move down, $0DA992 down-left, $0DA9B4 down-
;;     right, $0DA9D6/$0DA9EF previous/next screen.
;; Parameters: Y: [$57] position; X: object ID index.
;; Called by:
;;     $0D:BB65: Forest tree top and ice blue pipe
$0D:A8C3 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] position of the object
$0D:A8C5 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:A8C7 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:A8C9 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = $02 = [$59] AND $0F: width - 1
$0D:A8CB 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$0D:A8CD A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:A8CF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:A8D0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:A8D1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:A8D2 4A           LSR                             ; } $01 = [$59] >> 4: height - 1
$0D:A8D3 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$0D:A8D5 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the Map16 pointer to [$04]-[$05]
$0D:A8D8 E0 04        CPX.B #$04                      ; \
$0D:A8DA D0 52        BNE $A92E                       ; / Only X = 4 (coins) checks item memory; other tiles go straight to drawing
$0D:A8DC 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:A8DD 48           PHA                             ; |
$0D:A8DE 98           TYA                             ; } Push X and Y
$0D:A8DF 48           PHA                             ; /
$0D:A8E0 AE BE 13     LDX.W $13BE                     ; X = [$13BE]: item memory setting (selects which item memory table)
$0D:A8E3 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; \
$0D:A8E5 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:A8E6 7F AE A8 0D  ADC.L $A8AE,X                   ; } $08 = $19F8 + [DATA_0DA8AE+X] (low byte): item memory table pointer
$0D:A8EA 85 08        STA $08                         ; /
$0D:A8EC A9 19        LDA.B #$19                      ; \
$0D:A8EE 7F B1 A8 0D  ADC.L $A8B1,X                   ; } $09 = $19 + [DATA_0DA8B1+X] + carry (high byte)
$0D:A8F2 85 09        STA $09                         ; /
$0D:A8F4 AD A1 1B     LDA.W $1BA1                     ; \
$0D:A8F7 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0D:A8F8 0A           ASL                             ; } $0E = current screen number [$1BA1] * 4: 4 bytes of item memory per screen
$0D:A8F9 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; /
$0D:A8FB A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$0D:A8FD 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; } Bit 4 of [$0A] set?
$0D:A8FF F0 06        BEQ $A907                       ; /
$0D:A901 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$0D:A903 09 02        ORA.B #$02                      ; } Yes: $0E |= 2 (lower half of the screen)
$0D:A905 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; /
$0D:A907 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:A908 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; } Bit 3 of the column index Y set?
$0D:A90A F0 06        BEQ $A912                       ; /
$0D:A90C A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$0D:A90E 09 01        ORA.B #$01                      ; } Yes: $0E |= 1 (right half of the screen)
$0D:A910 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; /
$0D:A912 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:A913 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; } X = column index AND 7: bit number
$0D:A915 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:A916 A4 0E        LDY $0E                         ; \
$0D:A918 B1 08        LDA ($08),Y                     ; |
$0D:A91A 3F A6 A8 0D  AND.L $A8A6,X                   ; } $0F = item memory byte [($08)+$0E] AND bit mask: nonzero if this coin was collected
$0D:A91E 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; /
$0D:A920 68           PLA                             ; \
$0D:A921 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:A922 68           PLA                             ; } Pop Y and X
$0D:A923 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:A924 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; A = collected bit
$0D:A926 F0 06        BEQ $A92E                       ; Not collected: draw the tile normally
$0D:A928 20 5D A9     JSR.W $A95D                     ; \
$0D:A92B 4C 43 A9     JMP.W $A943                     ; / Collected: skip the tile (advance one column) and move on

$0D:A92E BF B4 A8 0D  LDA.L $A8B4,X                   ; \
$0D:A932 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / $0C = Map16 tile for object ID X [DATA_0DA8B4+X]
$0D:A934 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; Set the Map16 high byte to 0 (page 0)
$0D:A937 E0 07        CPX.B #$07                      ; \
$0D:A939 30 03        BMI $A93E                       ; } If X >= 7, set page 1 instead
$0D:A93B 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; /
$0D:A93E A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; \
$0D:A940 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Add tile $0C and advance one tile right
$0D:A943 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; Columns left in the row: $02--
$0D:A945 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; \
$0D:A947 10 8F        BPL $A8D8                       ; / Loop while $02 >= 0
$0D:A949 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; \
$0D:A94C 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; / Reload the row start pointer and move down one row
$0D:A94F A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:A951 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = $00: reset the width counter
$0D:A953 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:A955 30 03        BMI $A95A                       ; / Rows left: $01--; done when negative
$0D:A957 4C D8 A8     JMP.W $A8D8                     ; Next row

$0D:A95A 60           RTS                             ; Return

;This is the code to add a tile and move the pointer/index one tile to the right.
$0D:A95B 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; Store tile [A] at the current Map16 position
$0D:A95D C8           INY                             ; Y++: next column
$0D:A95E 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:A95F 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Crossed into the next screen (column index back to 0)? Else return
$0D:A961 D0 19        BNE $A97C                       ; /
$0D:A963 A5 6B        LDA $6B                         ; \
$0D:A965 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:A966 69 B0        ADC.B #$B0                      ; } $6B += $B0 (low byte)
$0D:A968 85 6B        STA $6B                         ; /
$0D:A96A 85 6E        STA $6E                         ; Mirror into [$6E]
$0D:A96C A5 6C        LDA $6C                         ; \
$0D:A96E 69 01        ADC.B #$01                      ; } $6C += 1 + carry: pointer is now $1B0 bytes on (next screen)
$0D:A970 85 6C        STA $6C                         ; /
$0D:A972 85 6F        STA $6F                         ; Mirror into [$6F]
$0D:A974 EE A1 1B     INC.W $1BA1                     ; Screen number [$1BA1]++
$0D:A977 A5 57        LDA $57                         ; \
$0D:A979 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; } Y = [$57] AND $F0: column 0 of the current row
$0D:A97B A8           TAY                             ; /
$0D:A97C 60           RTS                             ; Return

;This is the code to move the pointer down one tile from the starting position.
$0D:A97D A5 57        LDA $57                         ; \
$0D:A97F 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:A980 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } $57 += $10: move the object position down one row
$0D:A982 85 57        STA $57                         ; /
$0D:A984 A8           TAY                             ; \
$0D:A985 90 0A        BCC $A991                       ; / Y = new position; no carry: nothing else to update
$0D:A987 A5 6C        LDA $6C                         ; \
$0D:A989 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; } Carry: [$6C] += 1 (carry is set)
$0D:A98B 85 6C        STA $6C                         ; /
$0D:A98D 85 6F        STA $6F                         ; Mirror into [$6F]
$0D:A98F 85 05        STA $05                         ; Also update the saved pointer high byte [$05]
$0D:A991 60           RTS                             ; Return

;Move pointer down and left
$0D:A992 A5 57        LDA $57                         ; \
$0D:A994 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:A995 69 0F        ADC.B #$0F                      ; } Y = [$57] + $0F: one row down, one column left
$0D:A997 A8           TAY                             ; /
$0D:A998 90 03        BCC $A99D                       ; No carry: no screen change
$0D:A99A 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; Unused: bump the pointer high byte
$0D:A99D 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:A99E 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Column wrapped to $0F (left of column 0)?
$0D:A9A0 C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; /
$0D:A9A2 D0 0D        BNE $A9B1                       ; No: save the index
$0D:A9A4 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:A9A5 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:A9A6 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Y += $10: move down another row
$0D:A9A8 A8           TAY                             ; /
$0D:A9A9 90 03        BCC $A9AE                       ; \
$0D:A9AB 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; / On carry, bump the pointer high byte
$0D:A9AE 20 D6 A9     JSR.W $A9D6                     ; Go back one screen
$0D:A9B1 84 57        STY $57                         ; Save the new position: [$57] = Y
$0D:A9B3 60           RTS                             ; Return

;Move pointer down and right
$0D:A9B4 A5 57        LDA $57                         ; \
$0D:A9B6 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:A9B7 69 11        ADC.B #$11                      ; } Y = [$57] + $11: one row down, one column right
$0D:A9B9 A8           TAY                             ; /
$0D:A9BA 90 03        BCC $A9BF                       ; No carry: no screen change
$0D:A9BC 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; Unused: bump the pointer high byte
$0D:A9BF 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:A9C0 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Column wrapped to 0 (right of column $F)?
$0D:A9C2 C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; /
$0D:A9C4 10 0D        BPL $A9D3                       ; No: save the index
$0D:A9C6 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:A9C7 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:A9C8 E9 10        SBC.B #$10                      ; } Y -= $10: move back up a row
$0D:A9CA A8           TAY                             ; /
$0D:A9CB B0 03        BCS $A9D0                       ; \
$0D:A9CD 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; / On borrow, bump the pointer high byte
$0D:A9D0 20 EF A9     JSR.W $A9EF                     ; Go forward one screen
$0D:A9D3 84 57        STY $57                         ; Save the new position: [$57] = Y
$0D:A9D5 60           RTS                             ; Return

;This code goes back one screen. Also updates preserved pointer.
$0D:A9D6 A5 6B        LDA $6B                         ; \
$0D:A9D8 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:A9D9 E9 B0        SBC.B #$B0                      ; } $6B -= $B0 (low byte)
$0D:A9DB 85 6B        STA $6B                         ; /
$0D:A9DD 85 6E        STA $6E                         ; Mirror into [$6E]
$0D:A9DF 85 04        STA $04                         ; Update the saved pointer low byte [$04]
$0D:A9E1 A5 6C        LDA $6C                         ; \
$0D:A9E3 E9 01        SBC.B #$01                      ; } $6C -= 1 + borrow: pointer is now $1B0 bytes back (previous screen)
$0D:A9E5 85 6C        STA $6C                         ; /
$0D:A9E7 85 6F        STA $6F                         ; Mirror into [$6F]
$0D:A9E9 85 05        STA $05                         ; Update the saved pointer high byte [$05]
$0D:A9EB CE A1 1B     DEC.W $1BA1                     ; Screen number [$1BA1]--
$0D:A9EE 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This code goes forwards one screen. Also updates preserved pointer.
$0D:A9EF A5 6B        LDA $6B                         ; \
$0D:A9F1 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:A9F2 69 B0        ADC.B #$B0                      ; } $6B += $B0 (low byte)
$0D:A9F4 85 6B        STA $6B                         ; /
$0D:A9F6 85 6E        STA $6E                         ; Mirror into [$6E]
$0D:A9F8 85 04        STA $04                         ; Update the saved pointer low byte [$04]
$0D:A9FA A5 6C        LDA $6C                         ; \
$0D:A9FC 69 01        ADC.B #$01                      ; } $6C += 1 + carry: pointer is now $1B0 bytes on (next screen)
$0D:A9FE 85 6C        STA $6C                         ; /
$0D:AA00 85 6F        STA $6F                         ; Mirror into [$6F]
$0D:AA02 85 05        STA $05                         ; Update the saved pointer high byte [$05]
$0D:AA04 EE A1 1B     INC.W $1BA1                     ; Screen number [$1BA1]++
$0D:AA07 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This one sets the map16 page for the current object to #01.

;;; $AA08: Set Map16 high byte at pointer (Sta1To6ePointer) ;;;
;; Sta1To6ePointer: store 1 to [$6E],Y (tile page $1xx). $0DAA0F: store [A] to [$6E],Y (page 0 when entered
;;     via StzTo6ePointer0080E7).
;; Called by:
;;     $0D:A5BC: Draw single-tile extended objects
;;     $0D:A641: Draw single-tile extended objects
;;     $0D:A65D: Draw small slopes (unused objects)
;;     $0D:A66D: Draw small slopes (unused objects)
;;     $0D:A680: Draw triangles, midway point and pointer helpers
;;     $0D:A68A: Draw triangles, midway point and pointer helpers
;;     $0D:A814: Object: steep slope, vertical-level safe
;;     $0D:A820: Object: steep slope, vertical-level safe
;;     $0D:A84D: Object: normal slope, vertical-level safe
;;     $0D:A857: Object: normal slope, vertical-level safe
;;     $0D:A863: Object: normal slope, vertical-level safe
;;     $0D:A86D: Object: normal slope, vertical-level safe
;;     ... and 207 more
$0D:AA08 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1
$0D:AA0A 97 6E        STA [$6E],Y                     ; Set the Map16 high byte at this position to 1 (tile page $1xx)
$0D:AA0C 60           RTS                             ; Return

;This one sets the map16 page for the current object to #00.
$0D:AA0F 97 6E        STA [$6E],Y                     ; Set the Map16 high byte at this position to [A] (0 via StzTo6ePointer0080E7)
$0D:AA11 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This is the code for the vertical pipes.

;;; $AA12..AA21: Map16 tiles: vertical pipes ;;;
;; By type 0-4: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right (0 = unused).
$0D:AA12              .db $33,$37,$39,$00,$00         ; Top-left tiles by type 0-4: $33, $37, $39, -, -

$0D:AA17              .db $34,$38,$3A,$00,$00         ; Top-right tiles by type: $34, $38, $3A, -, -

$0D:AA1C              .db $00,$00,$39,$33,$37         ; Bottom-left tiles by type: -, -, $39, $33, $37

$0D:AA21              .db $00,$00,$3A,$34,$38         ; Bottom-right tiles by type: -, -, $3A, $34, $38


;;; $AA26: Object: vertical pipe ;;;
;; Height in high nibble of [$59], type in low nibble. Types 0-2 have a top cap, types 2-4 a bottom cap, 5 =
;;     endless pipe.
;; Body tiles $135/$136; endless uses $168/$169.
$0D:AA26 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] position of the object
$0D:AA28 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:AA2A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AA2B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AA2C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AA2D 4A           LSR                             ; } $00 = [$59] >> 4: pipe height
$0D:AA2E 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:AA30 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:AA32 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } X = [$59] AND $0F: pipe type (0-4, 5 = endless)
$0D:AA34 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:AA35 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the Map16 pointer to [$04]-[$05]
$0D:AA38 E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; \
$0D:AA3A 10 16        BPL $AA52                       ; / Type >= 3: no top cap
$0D:AA3C 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AA3F BF 12 AA 0D  LDA.L $AA12,X                   ; } Set page 1, add top-left tile [DATA_0DAA12+X], advance right
$0D:AA43 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:AA46 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AA49 BF 17 AA 0D  LDA.L $AA17,X                   ; } Set page 1, store top-right tile [DATA_0DAA17+X]
$0D:AA4D 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:AA4F 4C 77 AA     JMP.W $AA77                     ; Go to the next row

$0D:AA52 E0 05        CPX.B #$05                      ; \
$0D:AA54 D0 12        BNE $AA68                       ; / Type 5 (endless pipe)?
$0D:AA56 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AA59 A9 68        LDA.B #$68                      ; } Set page 1, add left tile $168, advance right
$0D:AA5B 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:AA5E 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AA61 A9 69        LDA.B #$69                      ; } Set page 1, store right tile $169
$0D:AA63 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:AA65 4C 77 AA     JMP.W $AA77                     ; Go to the next row

$0D:AA68 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AA6B A9 35        LDA.B #$35                      ; } Set page 1, add left body tile $135, advance right
$0D:AA6D 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:AA70 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AA73 A9 36        LDA.B #$36                      ; } Set page 1, store right body tile $136
$0D:AA75 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:AA77 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; \
$0D:AA7A 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; / Reload the row start pointer and go to the next row
$0D:AA7D E0 05        CPX.B #$05                      ; \
$0D:AA7F F0 04        BEQ $AA85                       ; / Type 5 (endless): no special bottom
$0D:AA81 E0 02        CPX.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:AA83 10 07        BPL $AA8C                       ; / Type >= 2: has a special bottom, handle below
$0D:AA85 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:AA87 10 C9        BPL $AA52                       ; / Rows left: $00--; loop while >= 0
$0D:AA89 4C A3 AA     JMP.W $AAA3                     ; Done

$0D:AA8C C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:AA8E D0 D8        BNE $AA68                       ; / Rows left: $00--; if more, draw another body row
$0D:AA90 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AA93 BF 1C AA 0D  LDA.L $AA1C,X                   ; } Last row: set page 1, add bottom-left tile [DATA_0DAA1C+X], advance right
$0D:AA97 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:AA9A 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AA9D BF 21 AA 0D  LDA.L $AA21,X                   ; } Set page 1, store bottom-right tile [DATA_0DAA21+X]
$0D:AAA1 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:AAA3 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Horizontal pipes

;;; $AAA4..AAB2: Map16 tiles: horizontal pipes ;;;
;; End tiles then middle tiles, top/bottom pair per type.
$0D:AAA4              .db $3B,$3C                     ; Type 0 end tiles: top $3B, bottom $3C
$0D:AAA6              .db $3B,$3F                     ; Type 1 end tiles: top $3B, bottom $3F
$0D:AAA8              .db $3B,$3C                     ; Type 2 end tiles: top $3B, bottom $3C
$0D:AAAA              .db $3B,$3F                     ; Type 3 end tiles: top $3B, bottom $3F

$0D:AAAC              .db $3D,$3E                     ; Type 0 middle tiles: top $3D, bottom $3E
$0D:AAAE              .db $3D,$3E                     ; Type 1 middle tiles: top $3D, bottom $3E
$0D:AAB0              .db $3D,$3E                     ; Type 2 middle tiles: top $3D, bottom $3E
$0D:AAB2              .db $3D,$3E                     ; Type 3 middle tiles: top $3D, bottom $3E


;;; $AAB4: Objects: horizontal pipe, bullet shooter, slope dispatch ;;;
;; Horizontal pipe: size in low nibble, type in high nibble (types 2-3 end on the right).
;; Bullet shooter: height in high nibble, tiles $141/$142/$143.
;; Slope: type = [$59] AND $0F dispatched through PtrsLong0DAB50.
$0D:AAB4 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] position of the object
$0D:AAB6 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:AAB8 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:AABA 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = $01 = [$59] AND $0F: pipe length
$0D:AABC 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$0D:AABE A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:AAC0 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$0D:AAC2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AAC3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AAC4 4A           LSR                             ; } X = ([$59] AND $F0) >> 3: type * 2 (row index: top, then bottom)
$0D:AAC5 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:AAC6 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the Map16 pointer to [$04]-[$05]
$0D:AAC9 E0 04        CPX.B #$04                      ; \
$0D:AACB 10 0D        BPL $AADA                       ; / X >= 4: end is on the right, start with middle tiles
$0D:AACD 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AAD0 BF A4 AA 0D  LDA.L $AAA4,X                   ; } Set page 1, add end tile [DATA_0DAAA4+X], advance right
$0D:AAD4 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:AAD7 4C E4 AA     JMP.W $AAE4                     ; Continue with middle tiles

$0D:AADA 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AADD BF AC AA 0D  LDA.L $AAAC,X                   ; } Set page 1, add middle tile [DATA_0DAAAC+X], advance right
$0D:AAE1 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:AAE4 E0 04        CPX.B #$04                      ; \
$0D:AAE6 10 07        BPL $AAEF                       ; / X >= 4: right-end handling below
$0D:AAE8 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:AAEA 10 EE        BPL $AADA                       ; / Left-end pipe: length left $01--; loop while >= 0
$0D:AAEC 4C FC AA     JMP.W $AAFC                     ; Row done

$0D:AAEF C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:AAF1 D0 D6        BNE $AAC9                       ; / Right-end pipe: $01--; loop until zero
$0D:AAF3 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AAF6 BF A4 AA 0D  LDA.L $AAA4,X                   ; } Set page 1, store end tile [DATA_0DAAA4+X] at the last position
$0D:AAFA 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:AAFC A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:AAFE 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = $00: reload the length
$0D:AB00 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; \
$0D:AB03 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; / Reload the row start pointer and move down one row
$0D:AB06 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:AB07 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0D:AB08 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } X++; draw the second row (bottom) of the pipe once, then finish
$0D:AB0A D0 BD        BNE $AAC9                       ; /
$0D:AB0C 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Bullet shooter
$0D:AB0D A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] position of the object
$0D:AB0F A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:AB11 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AB12 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AB13 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AB14 4A           LSR                             ; } X = [$59] >> 4: height - 1 (width bits unused)
$0D:AB15 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:AB16 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AB19 A9 41        LDA.B #$41                      ; } Set page 1, store top tile $141 (Bullet Bill shooter)
$0D:AB1B 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:AB1D 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; \
$0D:AB20 CA           DEX                             ; / Move down a row; done if no more height
$0D:AB21 30 1A        BMI $AB3D                       ;/
$0D:AB23 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AB26 A9 42        LDA.B #$42                      ; } Set page 1, store middle tile $142
$0D:AB28 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:AB2A 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; \
$0D:AB2D CA           DEX                             ; } Move down a row; done if no more height
$0D:AB2E 30 0D        BMI $AB3D                       ; /
$0D:AB30 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AB33 A9 43        LDA.B #$43                      ; } Set page 1, store bottom tile $143
$0D:AB35 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:AB37 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; \
$0D:AB3A CA           DEX                             ; } Move down a row; repeat the bottom tile for the remaining height
$0D:AB3B 10 F3        BPL $AB30                       ; /
$0D:AB3D 60           RTS                             ; Return

;Slopes (what a big code...)
$0D:AB3E A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:AB40 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; / A = slope type = [$59] AND $0F
$0D:AB42 C9 0A        CMP.B #$0A                      ; \
$0D:AB44 30 06        BMI $AB4C                       ; / Type < 10: done
$0D:AB46 38           SEC                             ; \
$0D:AB47 E9 0A        SBC.B #$0A                      ; } Probably unused: types 10-15 wrap to 0-5
$0D:AB49 4C 42 AB     JMP.W $AB42                     ; /

$0D:AB4C 22 FA 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtrLong            ; Jump to the slope routine for the type (pointer table below)


;;; $AB50: Pointer table: slope types; normal left slope (PtrsLong0DAB50) ;;;
;; 10 long pointers by slope type. Followed by the normal left slope routine, which draws the surface tiles
;;     $196/$19B, body $1DE/$1E6 and fill $03F row by row.
$0D:AB50 6E AB 0D     .dw $AB6E .db :$CODE_0DAB6E     ; Type 0: normal slope left
$0D:AB53 21 AC 0D     .dw $AC21 .db :$CODE_0DAC21     ; Type 1: steep slope left
$0D:AB56 92 AC 0D     .dw $AC92 .db :$CODE_0DAC92     ; Type 2: gradual slope left
$0D:AB59 44 AD 0D     .dw $AD44 .db :$CODE_0DAD44     ; Type 3: normal slope right
$0D:AB5C A3 AD 0D     .dw $ADA3 .db :$CODE_0DADA3     ; Type 4: steep slope right
$0D:AB5F EB AD 0D     .dw $ADEB .db :$CODE_0DADEB     ; Type 5: gradual slope right
$0D:AB62 6D AE 0D     .dw $AE6D .db :$CODE_0DAE6D     ; Type 6: normal slope left, upside down
$0D:AB65 FC AE 0D     .dw $AEFC .db :$CODE_0DAEFC     ; Type 7: normal slope right, upside down
$0D:AB68 61 AF 0D     .dw $AF61 .db :$CODE_0DAF61     ; Type 8: steep slope left, upside down
$0D:AB6B EA AF 0D     .dw $AFEA .db :$CODE_0DAFEA     ; Type 9: steep slope right, upside down


;Normal slope left
$0D:AB6E A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] position of the object
$0D:AB70 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0D:AB72 85 02        STA $02                         ; } $02 = $00 = 1: tiles on the top
$0D:AB74 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:AB76 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the Map16 pointer to [$04]-[$05]
$0D:AB79 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:AB7B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AB7C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AB7D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AB7E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:AB7F 85 00        STA $00                         ; } $00 = ([$59] >> 4) + 1: rows in the slope
$0D:AB81 E6 00        INC $00                         ; /
$0D:AB83 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = [$02]: tiles to draw in this row
$0D:AB85 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AB88 A9 96        LDA.B #$96                      ; } Set page 1, add slope surface tile $196 (blank-aware helper)
$0D:AB8A 20 FD AB     JSR.W $ABFD                     ; /
$0D:AB8D 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AB90 A9 9B        LDA.B #$9B                      ; } Set page 1, add slope surface tile $19B
$0D:AB92 20 FD AB     JSR.W $ABFD                     ; /
$0D:AB95 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:AB96 CA           DEX                             ; } X -= 2; no more tiles in this row: go to next row
$0D:AB97 30 1F        BMI $ABB8                       ; /
$0D:AB99 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:AB9C A9 DE        LDA.B #$DE                      ; } Set page 1, add slope body tile $1DE, advance right
$0D:AB9E 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:ABA1 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:ABA4 A9 E6        LDA.B #$E6                      ; } Set page 1, add slope body tile $1E6, advance right
$0D:ABA6 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:ABA9 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:ABAA 4C B5 AB     JMP.W $ABB5                     ; / X--, then jump into the fill loop

$0D:ABAD 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:ABB0 A9 3F        LDA.B #$3F                      ; } Set page 0, add solid fill tile $3F, advance right
$0D:ABB2 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:ABB5 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:ABB6 10 F5        BPL $ABAD                       ; / X--; repeat while >= 0
$0D:ABB8 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Reload the row start pointer
$0D:ABBB E6 02        INC $02                         ; \
$0D:ABBD E6 02        INC $02                         ; / $02 += 2: the next row has two more tiles
$0D:ABBF C6 00        DEC $00                         ; Rows left: $00--
$0D:ABC1 F0 29        BEQ $ABEC                       ; Zero: last row, no surface tiles
$0D:ABC3 10 03        BPL $ABC8                       ; \
$0D:ABC5 4C F6 AB     JMP.W $ABF6                     ; / Negative: object finished

$0D:ABC8 A5 57        LDA $57                         ; \
$0D:ABCA 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:ABCB 69 0E        ADC.B #$0E                      ; } Y = [$57] + $0E: one row down, two columns left
$0D:ABCD A8           TAY                             ; /
$0D:ABCE 90 03        BCC $ABD3                       ; No carry: no screen change
$0D:ABD0 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; Unused: bump the pointer high byte
$0D:ABD3 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:ABD4 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Column wrapped past the left edge (>= $0E)?
$0D:ABD6 C9 0E        CMP.B #$0E                      ; /
$0D:ABD8 30 0D        BMI $ABE7                       ; No: keep the position
$0D:ABDA 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:ABDB 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:ABDC 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Y += $10: move down another row
$0D:ABDE A8           TAY                             ; /
$0D:ABDF 90 03        BCC $ABE4                       ; \
$0D:ABE1 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; / On carry, bump the pointer high byte
$0D:ABE4 20 D6 A9     JSR.W $A9D6                     ; Go back one screen
$0D:ABE7 84 57        STY $57                         ; Save the new position: [$57] = Y
$0D:ABE9 4C 83 AB     JMP.W $AB83                     ; Draw the next row

$0D:ABEC A6 02        LDX $02                         ; \
$0D:ABEE CA           DEX                             ; } X = [$02] - 2
$0D:ABEF CA           DEX                             ; /
$0D:ABF0 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; \
$0D:ABF3 4C 99 AB     JMP.W $AB99                     ; / Move down a row and draw the body tiles of the last row

$0D:ABF6 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This code adds a tile for the slopes (only used for the ones with blank pixels on them)

;;; $ABF7..ABFA: Data: slope tile adjustment tables ;;;
;; Tiles $3F, $01, $03 and the amounts added to them for the slope surface tile helper.
$0D:ABF7              .db $3F,$01,$03                 ; Tiles that need adjusting under a slope surface tile: $3F, $01, $03

$0D:ABFA              .db $01,$03,$04                 ; Amount to add for those tiles: 1, 3, 4


;;; $ABFD: Slope object draw routines (all 8 slopes) ;;;
;; Level object draw code for the slope objects: steep/normal/gradual, left/right, plus upside-down variants.
;; The first routine (0DABFD) writes a slope tile, adding an offset when the existing Map16 tile is $3F, $101
;;     or $103.
;; Each slope draws row by row into the Map16 buffer, adding slope, slope-assist and dirt/ground tiles ($03F,
;;     $165).
;; Parameters: [$57] = start index, [$59] = size (high nibble = length/height), [$6B]/[$6E] = Map16 pointers.
;; The upside-down routines use [$01] as an is-first-row flag.
;; Called by:
;;     $0D:AB8A: Pointer table: slope types; normal left slope (PtrsLong0DAB50)
;;     $0D:AB92: Pointer table: slope types; normal left slope (PtrsLong0DAB50)
;;     $0D:AC3B: Slope object draw routines (all 8 slopes)
;;     $0D:ACAE: Slope object draw routines (all 8 slopes)
;;     $0D:ACB6: Slope object draw routines (all 8 slopes)

;;; $B114: Fix up ledge top tile over existing tile ;;;
;; Parameters: A = tile to place, X = ledge type, Y = index. Returns: A = tile to place (possibly replaced via
;;     $B0F0/$B102 or incremented).
;; Called by:
;;     $0D:B092: Draw ledge edge object
$0D:B114 E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; \
$0D:B116 30 08        BMI $B120                       ; |
$0D:B118 E0 09        CPX.B #$09                      ; |

$0D:B122 F0 37        BEQ $B15B                       ;/
$0D:B124 86 0B        STX $0B                         ; [$0B] = X (save object type)
$0D:B126 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; [$0C] = A (tile to place)
$0D:B128 A2 11        LDX.B #$11                      ; X = $11 (18 table entries)
$0D:B12A B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; A = tile currently at the position
$0D:B12C DF F0 B0 0D  CMP.L $B0F0,X                   ; Compare with the $B0F0 table
$0D:B130 F0 20        BEQ $B152                       ; Match: use the replacement

$0D:B135 C9 25        CMP.B #$25                      ; \

$0D:B13B C9 01        CMP.B #$01                      ; |
$0D:B13D F0 0C        BEQ $B14B                       ; |
$0D:B13F C9 03        CMP.B #$03                      ; |
$0D:B141 F0 08        BEQ $B14B                       ; |
$0D:B143 C9 45        CMP.B #$45                      ; |
$0D:B145 F0 04        BEQ $B14B                       ; |
$0D:B147 C9 48        CMP.B #$48                      ; |
$0D:B149 D0 02        BNE $B14D                       ; / If placing tile $101, $103, $145 or $148...
$0D:B14B E6 0C        INC $0C                         ; ...use the next tile number
$0D:B14D A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; \
$0D:B14F 4C 59 B1     JMP.W $B159                     ; / A = tile to place, return

$0D:B152 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Set Map16 page 1
$0D:B155 BF 02 B1 0D  LDA.L $B102,X                   ; A = replacement tile from $B102
$0D:B159 A6 0B        LDX $0B                         ; Restore X (object type)
