$0D:B16C              .db $96,$97,$9B,$9C,$A0,$A1,$A5,$A6 ; $196,$197,$19B,$19C,$1A0,$1A1,$1A5,$1A6
$0D:B174              .db $AA,$AB,$AF,$B0,$E2,$E4     ; $1AA,$1AB,$1AF,$1B0,$1E2,$1E4


;;; $B17A..B192: Table: replacement middle tiles ;;;
$0D:B17A              .db $70,$70,$75,$75,$7A,$7A,$7F,$7F ; Replacement tiles $170,$170,$175,$175,$17A,$17A,$17F,$17F
$0D:B182              .db $84,$84,$89,$89,$8E,$8E,$93,$93 ; $184,$184,$189,$189,$18E,$18E,$193,$193
$0D:B18A              .db $98,$98,$9D,$9D,$A2,$A2,$A7,$A7 ; $198,$198,$19D,$19D,$1A2,$1A2,$1A7,$1A7
$0D:B192              .db $AC,$AC,$B1,$B1,$E9,$EA     ; $1AC,$1AC,$1B1,$1B1,$1E9,$1EA


;;; $B198: Ledge middle-tile fixup and ledge objects ;;;
;; First routine fixes up the middle tile like $B114 (via $B15C/$B17A).
;; Then Long ground ledge (width = whole size byte, height 3) and Standard ledge (width = low nibble, height =
;;     high nibble): a top row of tile $100 then rows of ground tile $03F.
;; Called by:
;;     $0D:B0B4: Draw ledge edge object
;;     $0D:B0D6: Draw ledge edge object
$0D:B198 E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; \
$0D:B19A 30 08        BMI $B1A4                       ; |
$0D:B19C E0 07        CPX.B #$07                      ; |
$0D:B19E 30 27        BMI $B1C7                       ; |
$0D:B1A0 E0 09        CPX.B #$09                      ; |
$0D:B1A2 10 23        BPL $B1C7                       ; / Run only for types 0-2 and 7-8
$0D:B1A4 E0 02        CPX.B #$02                      ; Type 2: no fixup
$0D:B1A6 F0 1F        BEQ $B1C7                       ;/
$0D:B1A8 86 0B        STX $0B                         ; [$0B] = X (save object type)
$0D:B1AA 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; [$0C] = A (tile to place)
$0D:B1AC A2 1D        LDX.B #$1D                      ; X = $1D (30 table entries)
$0D:B1AE B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; A = tile currently at the position
$0D:B1B0 DF 5C B1 0D  CMP.L $B15C,X                   ; Compare with the $B15C table
$0D:B1B4 F0 08        BEQ $B1BE                       ; Match: use the replacement
$0D:B1B6 CA           DEX                             ; Next entry
$0D:B1B7 10 F7        BPL $B1B0                       ; Loop
$0D:B1B9 A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; \
$0D:B1BB 4C C5 B1     JMP.W $B1C5                     ; / No match: keep the tile to place

$0D:B1BE 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Set Map16 page 1
$0D:B1C1 BF 7A B1 0D  LDA.L $B17A,X                   ; A = replacement tile from $B17A
$0D:B1C5 A6 0B        LDX $0B                         ; Restore X (object type)
$0D:B1C7 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Long ground ledge
$0D:B1C8 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B1CA 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0D:B1CC AA           TAX                             ; / [$00] = X = width (whole size byte)
$0D:B1CD A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:B1CF 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = 2 (height)
$0D:B1D1 4C E3 B1     JMP.W $B1E3                     ; Go to loop


;Standard ledge
$0D:B1D4 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B1D6 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:B1D8 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0D:B1DA AA           TAX                             ; / [$00] = X = width (low nibble)
$0D:B1DB A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B1DD 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B1DE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B1DF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B1E0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B1E1 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = height (high nibble)
$0D:B1E3 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save Map16 pointer
$0D:B1E6 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = start position [$57]
$0D:B1E8 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B1EB A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; |
$0D:B1ED 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Add top tile $100 (page 1)
$0D:B1F0 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:B1F1 E0 FF        CPX.B #$FF                      ; |
$0D:B1F3 D0 F3        BNE $B1E8                       ; / X--, loop until it wraps below zero
$0D:B1F5 4C 05 B2     JMP.W $B205                     ; Go to row done

$0D:B1F8 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B1FB A9 3F        LDA.B #$3F                      ; |
$0D:B1FD 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Add ground tile $03F (page 0)
$0D:B200 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:B201 E0 FF        CPX.B #$FF                      ; |
$0D:B203 D0 F3        BNE $B1F8                       ; / X--, loop until it wraps below zero
$0D:B205 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore Map16 pointer
$0D:B208 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move pointer down one row
$0D:B20B A6 00        LDX $00                         ; \
$0D:B20D C6 02        DEC $02                         ; |
$0D:B20F 10 E7        BPL $B1F8                       ; / X = width; height--; loop for the next row
$0D:B211 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Midway/goal point

;;; $B212..B221: Table: midway and goal point tiles ;;;
;; Map16 tiles for the 3-tile-tall midway and goal posts, three columns per row (left, $025 middle, right).
$0D:B212              .db $2F,$25,$32                 ; Midway point top: $02F,$025,$032
$0D:B215              .db $30,$25,$33                 ; Midway point middle: $030,$025,$033
$0D:B218              .db $31,$25,$34                 ; Midway point bottom: $031,$025,$034

$0D:B21B              .db $39,$25,$3C                 ; Goal point top: $039,$025,$03C
$0D:B21E              .db $3A,$25,$3D                 ; Goal point middle: $03A,$025,$03D
$0D:B221              .db $3B,$25,$3E                 ; Goal point bottom: $03B,$025,$03E


;;; $B224: Level objects: midway/goal gate, coins ;;;
;; Three object routines in one section: the midway/goal gate (3 columns of top/middle/bottom tiles; type 0 =
;;     midway, else goal),
;; the Yoshi coin (2 tiles, skipped when item memory says it was collected) and the blue coin rectangle (tile
;;     $2C, skipping collected ones).
;; Parameters: [$57] = level position index, [$59] = size/type byte, writes Map16 tiles through the pointer at
;;     [$6B].
$0D:B224 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] (level position index)
$0D:B226 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B228 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:B22A 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = type (0 = midway gate, nonzero = goal gate)
$0D:B22C A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B22E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B22F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B230 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B231 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B232 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0D:B234 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$00] = [$01] = height (high nibble of [$59])
$0D:B236 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save map16 pointer
$0D:B239 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: column counter (left, middle, right)
$0D:B23B BF 12 B2 0D  LDA.L $B212,X                   ; \
$0D:B23F 85 03        STA $03                         ; |
$0D:B241 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; |
$0D:B243 F0 06        BEQ $B24B                       ; |
$0D:B245 BF 1B B2 0D  LDA.L $B21B,X                   ; |
$0D:B249 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = top tile of column X (midway table; goal table if type != 0)
$0D:B24B 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B24E A5 03        LDA $03                         ; |
$0D:B250 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Write top tile
$0D:B252 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:B253 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:B254 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0D:B256 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:B257 90 08        BCC $B261                       ; |
$0D:B259 A5 6C        LDA $6C                         ; |
$0D:B25B 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$0D:B25D 85 6C        STA $6C                         ; |
$0D:B25F 85 6F        STA $6F                         ; / Y += $10: move down one row (carry into the high pointer byte)
$0D:B261 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:B263 F0 2A        BEQ $B28F                       ; / Skip middle tiles if only one tile high
$0D:B265 BF 15 B2 0D  LDA.L $B215,X                   ; \
$0D:B269 85 03        STA $03                         ; |
$0D:B26B A5 02        LDA $02                         ; |
$0D:B26D F0 06        BEQ $B275                       ; |
$0D:B26F BF 1E B2 0D  LDA.L $B21E,X                   ; |
$0D:B273 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = middle tile of column X (midway or goal table)
$0D:B275 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B278 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; |
$0D:B27A 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Write middle tile
$0D:B27C 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:B27D 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:B27E 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0D:B280 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:B281 90 08        BCC $B28B                       ; |
$0D:B283 A5 6C        LDA $6C                         ; |
$0D:B285 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$0D:B287 85 6C        STA $6C                         ; |
$0D:B289 85 6F        STA $6F                         ; / Y += $10: move down one row
$0D:B28B C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:B28D D0 D6        BNE $B265                       ; / Repeat for each middle row
$0D:B28F BF 18 B2 0D  LDA.L $B218,X                   ; \
$0D:B293 85 03        STA $03                         ; |
$0D:B295 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; |
$0D:B297 F0 06        BEQ $B29F                       ; |
$0D:B299 BF 21 B2 0D  LDA.L $B221,X                   ; |
$0D:B29D 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = bottom tile of column X (midway or goal table)
$0D:B29F 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B2A2 A5 03        LDA $03                         ; |
$0D:B2A4 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Write bottom tile
$0D:B2A6 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore map16 pointer to the top of the column
$0D:B2A9 A5 57        LDA $57                         ; \
$0D:B2AB 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:B2AC 69 01        ADC.B #$01                      ; |
$0D:B2AE A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:B2AF 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:B2B1 D0 08        BNE $B2BB                       ; |
$0D:B2B3 20 EF A9     JSR.W $A9EF                     ; / Y = [$57]+1; at a subscreen boundary move pointer to next screen
$0D:B2B6 A5 57        LDA $57                         ; \
$0D:B2B8 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$0D:B2BA A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:B2BB 84 57        STY $57                         ; / [$57] = new column position
$0D:B2BD A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:B2BF 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = height again
$0D:B2C1 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:B2C2 E0 03        CPX.B #$03                      ; |
$0D:B2C4 F0 03        BEQ $B2C9                       ; |
$0D:B2C6 4C 3B B2     JMP.W $B23B                     ; / Next column; done after 3 columns

$0D:B2C9 60           RTS                             ; Return


;This is the code for the Yoshi coin.
$0D:B2CA AD BF 13     LDA.W $13BF                     ; \
$0D:B2CD 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B2CE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B2CF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B2D0 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:B2D1 AD BF 13     LDA.W $13BF                     ; |
$0D:B2D4 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$0D:B2D6 AA           TAX                             ; |
$0D:B2D7 B9 2F 1F     LDA.W $1F2F,Y                   ; |
$0D:B2DA 3F A6 A8 0D  AND.L $A8A6,X                   ; |
$0D:B2DE D0 E9        BNE $B2C9                       ; / Skip if this Yoshi coin ([$13BF] = its index) is already collected in [$1F2F]
$0D:B2E0 AE BE 13     LDX.W $13BE                     ; \
$0D:B2E3 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; |
$0D:B2E5 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:B2E6 7F AE A8 0D  ADC.L $A8AE,X                   ; |
$0D:B2EA 85 08        STA $08                         ; / [$08] = low byte of item memory table pointer ($19F8 + [$13BE] offset)
$0D:B2EC A9 19        LDA.B #$19                      ; \
$0D:B2EE 7F B1 A8 0D  ADC.L $A8B1,X                   ; |
$0D:B2F2 85 09        STA $09                         ; / [$09] = high byte of item memory table pointer
$0D:B2F4 AD A1 1B     LDA.W $1BA1                     ; \
$0D:B2F7 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0D:B2F8 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0D:B2F9 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / [$0E] = [$1BA1] * 4 (screen number part of item memory index)
$0D:B2FB A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$0D:B2FD 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; |
$0D:B2FF F0 06        BEQ $B307                       ; |
$0D:B301 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; |
$0D:B303 09 02        ORA.B #$02                      ; |
$0D:B305 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / If [$0A] bit 4 set, [$0E] |= 2 (high Y bit)
$0D:B307 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; \
$0D:B309 98           TYA                             ; |
$0D:B30A 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$0D:B30C F0 06        BEQ $B314                       ; |
$0D:B30E A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; |
$0D:B310 09 01        ORA.B #$01                      ; |
$0D:B312 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / If Y bit 3 set, [$0E] |= 1 (high X bit)
$0D:B314 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:B315 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$0D:B317 AA           TAX                             ; |
$0D:B318 A4 0E        LDY $0E                         ; |
$0D:B31A B1 08        LDA ($08),Y                     ; |
$0D:B31C 3F A6 A8 0D  AND.L $A8A6,X                   ; |
$0D:B320 D0 13        BNE $B335                       ; / X = Y AND 7; test the coin bit in item memory; skip if set
$0D:B322 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] (position)
$0D:B324 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B327 A9 2D        LDA.B #$2D                      ; |
$0D:B329 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Write top tile ($2D, Yoshi coin top)
$0D:B32B 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move pointer down one tile
$0D:B32E 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B331 A9 2E        LDA.B #$2E                      ; |
$0D:B333 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Write bottom tile ($2E, Yoshi coin bottom)
$0D:B335 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Blue coins
$0D:B336 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; \
$0D:B338 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; |
$0D:B33A 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:B33C 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0D:B33E AA           TAX                             ; |
$0D:B33F A5 59        LDA $59                         ; |
$0D:B341 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B342 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B343 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B344 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B345 85 01        STA $01                         ; / Y = position, X = width, [$00] = width, [$01] = height
$0D:B347 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Preserve pointer
$0D:B34A 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:B34B 48           PHA                             ; |
$0D:B34C 8A           TXA                             ; |
$0D:B34D 48           PHA                             ; / Save Y and X on the stack
$0D:B34E AE BE 13     LDX.W $13BE                     ; \
$0D:B351 A9 F8        LDA.B #$F8                      ; |
$0D:B353 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:B354 7F AE A8 0D  ADC.L $A8AE,X                   ; |
$0D:B358 85 08        STA $08                         ; / [$08] = low byte of item memory table pointer ($19F8 + [$13BE] offset)
$0D:B35A A9 19        LDA.B #$19                      ; \
$0D:B35C 7F B1 A8 0D  ADC.L $A8B1,X                   ; |
$0D:B360 85 09        STA $09                         ; / [$09] = high byte of item memory table pointer
$0D:B362 AD A1 1B     LDA.W $1BA1                     ; \
$0D:B365 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0D:B366 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0D:B367 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / [$0E] = [$1BA1] * 4 (screen number part of index)
$0D:B369 A5 0A        LDA $0A                         ; \
$0D:B36B 29 10        AND.B #$10                      ; |
$0D:B36D F0 06        BEQ $B375                       ; |
$0D:B36F A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; |
$0D:B371 09 02        ORA.B #$02                      ; |
$0D:B373 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / If [$0A] bit 4 set, [$0E] |= 2 (high Y bit)
$0D:B375 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:B376 29 08        AND.B #$08                      ; |
$0D:B378 F0 06        BEQ $B380                       ; |
$0D:B37A A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; |
$0D:B37C 09 01        ORA.B #$01                      ; |
$0D:B37E 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; / If Y bit 3 set, [$0E] |= 1 (high X bit)
$0D:B380 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:B381 29 07        AND.B #$07                      ; |
$0D:B383 AA           TAX                             ; / X = Y AND 7 (bit number within the byte)
$0D:B384 A4 0E        LDY $0E                         ; \
$0D:B386 B1 08        LDA ($08),Y                     ; |
$0D:B388 3F A6 A8 0D  AND.L $A8A6,X                   ; |
$0D:B38C 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / [$0F] = item memory bit for this coin (nonzero = already collected)
$0D:B38E 68           PLA                             ; \
$0D:B38F AA           TAX                             ; |
$0D:B390 68           PLA                             ; |
$0D:B391 A8           TAY                             ; / Restore X and Y
$0D:B392 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; Select map16 page (done even if the coin was taken)
$0D:B395 A9 2C        LDA.B #$2C                      ; \
$0D:B397 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / [$0C] = tile to place ($2C, coin)
$0D:B399 A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$0D:B39B F0 06        BEQ $B3A3                       ; / If already collected, only advance the pointer
$0D:B39D 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; Advance pointer without placing a tile
$0D:B3A0 4C A8 B3     JMP.W $B3A8                     ; Skip the placement

$0D:B3A3 A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; \
$0D:B3A5 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Place the coin tile and advance
$0D:B3A8 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:B3A9 10 9F        BPL $B34A                       ; / Next tile in the row
$0D:B3AB 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Reload pointer
$0D:B3AE 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move pointer downwards
$0D:B3B1 A6 00        LDX $00                         ; Reload width
$0D:B3B3 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:B3B5 30 03        BMI $B3BA                       ; } Check for end of the object
$0D:B3B7 4C 4A B3     JMP.W $B34A                     ; /

$0D:B3BA 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Rope/clouds

;;; $B3BB..B3BB: Map16 tiles: rope/cloud types ;;;
$0D:B3BB              .db $05,$06                     ; Map16 tile per type: $05, $06 (rope/cloud tiles)


;;; $B3BD: Level object: rope/cloud row ;;;
;; Places a horizontal run of tiles; type (high nibble of [$59]) picks $05 or $06, width is the low nibble.
$0D:B3BD A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Position
$0D:B3BF A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B3C1 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Width
$0D:B3C3 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:B3C5 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B3C7 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B3C8 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B3C9 4A           LSR                             ; } Type
$0D:B3CA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B3CB AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:B3CC 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B3CF BF BB B3 0D  LDA.L $B3BB,X                   ; } Add tile
$0D:B3D3 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:B3D6 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:B3D8 10 F2        BPL $B3CC                       ; / Check for end of the object
$0D:B3DA 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Water surface (both animated and nonanimated), lava surface, and net top edge

;;; $B3DB..B3DF: Map16 tiles: water/lava/net surfaces ;;;
;; Top-row tiles ($00,$01,$04,$08) then lower-row tiles ($02,$03,$05,$0B), indexed by object number - $17.
$0D:B3DB              .db $00,$01,$04,$08             ; Top-row tiles by type: $00, $01, $04, $08
$0D:B3DF              .db $02,$03,$05,$0B             ; Lower-row tiles by type: $02, $03, $05, $0B


;;; $B3E3: Level object: water/lava/net-top surface ;;;
;; Draws a rectangle: top row from the top table, remaining rows from the lower-row table. Type = object
;;     number - $17.
$0D:B3E3 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Position
$0D:B3E5 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B3E7 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:B3E9 85 00        STA $00                         ; } Width
$0D:B3EB 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$0D:B3ED A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B3EF 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B3F0 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B3F1 4A           LSR                             ; } Height
$0D:B3F2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B3F3 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$0D:B3F5 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:B3F6 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:B3F7 E9 17        SBC.B #$17                      ; |
$0D:B3F9 AA           TAX                             ; / X = object number - $17 (water/lava/net-top type)
$0D:B3FA 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Preserve pointer
$0D:B3FD 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B400 BF DB B3 0D  LDA.L $B3DB,X                   ; } Add top tile
$0D:B404 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:B407 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$0D:B409 10 F2        BPL $B3FD                       ; } Check for end of the row
$0D:B40B 4C 1C B4     JMP.W $B41C                     ; /

$0D:B40E 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B411 BF DF B3 0D  LDA.L $B3DF,X                   ; } Add middle tiles
$0D:B415 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:B418 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$0D:B41A 10 F2        BPL $B40E                       ; / Check for end of the row
$0D:B41C 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Reload pointer
$0D:B41F 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move pointer downwards
$0D:B422 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:B424 85 02        STA $02                         ; / Reload width
$0D:B426 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:B428 10 E4        BPL $B40E                       ; / Check for end of the object
$0D:B42A 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Donut bridge

;;; $B42B..B42C: Map16 tiles: donut bridge ;;;
;; Top $26, bottom $44.
$0D:B42B              .db $26                         ; Top tile
$0D:B42C              .db $44                         ; Bottom tile


;;; $B42D: Level objects: donut bridge, net bottom edge ;;;
;; Donut bridge: two rows, top tile $26 then bottom tile $44, width from the low nibble of [$59]. Net bottom
;;     edge: rows of tile $0B with a last row of $0E.
$0D:B42D A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Position
$0D:B42F A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B431 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:B433 85 00        STA $00                         ; } Width (the height bits are obviously unused)
$0D:B435 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$0D:B437 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Preserve pointer
$0D:B43A A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: row counter (0 = top tile row, 1 = bottom)
$0D:B43C 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B43F E0 00        CPX.B #$00                      ; |
$0D:B441 F0 03        BEQ $B446                       ; } Set map16 page
$0D:B443 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; /
$0D:B446 BF 2B B4 0D  LDA.L $B42B,X                   ; \
$0D:B44A 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Add tile
$0D:B44D C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:B44F 10 EB        BPL $B43C                       ; / Check for end of the row
$0D:B451 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Reload pointer
$0D:B454 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move pointer downwards
$0D:B457 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:B459 85 01        STA $01                         ; / Reload width
$0D:B45B E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:B45C E0 02        CPX.B #$02                      ; } Check for end of the object
$0D:B45E D0 DC        BNE $B43C                       ; /
$0D:B460 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Net bottom edge
$0D:B461 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Position
$0D:B463 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B465 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B466 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B467 4A           LSR                             ; } Height
$0D:B468 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B469 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:B46B A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B46D 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:B46F 85 01        STA $01                         ; } Width
$0D:B471 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:B472 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Preserve pointer
$0D:B475 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:B477 F0 17        BEQ $B490                       ; / Check if it's one tile high
$0D:B479 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B47C A9 0B        LDA.B #$0B                      ; } Add middle tiles
$0D:B47E 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:B481 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:B482 10 F5        BPL $B479                       ; / Check for end of the line
$0D:B484 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Reload pointer
$0D:B487 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move pointer downwards
$0D:B48A A6 01        LDX $01                         ; Reload size
$0D:B48C C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:B48E D0 E9        BNE $B479                       ; / Check if we're on the last line
$0D:B490 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B493 A9 0E        LDA.B #$0E                      ; } Add tile
$0D:B495 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:B498 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:B499 10 F5        BPL $B490                       ; / Check for end of the object
$0D:B49B 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Net vertical edge

;;; $B49C..B49C: Map16 tiles: net vertical edge ;;;
$0D:B49C              .db $0A,$0C                     ; Net vertical edge tiles by type: $0A, $0C


;;; $B49E: Level object: net vertical edge ;;;
;; Draws a column of tile $0A or $0C, merging with existing net tiles at the top and bottom via the two
;;     helpers below.
$0D:B49E A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Position
$0D:B4A0 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B4A2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B4A3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B4A4 4A           LSR                             ; } Height
$0D:B4A5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B4A6 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:B4A8 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B4AA 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Type
$0D:B4AC AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:B4AD BF 9C B4 0D  LDA.L $B49C,X                   ; \
$0D:B4B1 20 D9 B4     JSR.W $B4D9                     ; / Add top tile
$0D:B4B4 4C C0 B4     JMP.W $B4C0                     ; Go to loop

$0D:B4B7 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B4BA BF 9C B4 0D  LDA.L $B49C,X                   ; } Add middle tile
$0D:B4BE 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:B4C0 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:B4C1 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:B4C2 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0D:B4C4 A8           TAY                             ; } Move pointer downwards
$0D:B4C5 90 03        BCC $B4CA                       ; |
$0D:B4C7 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; /
$0D:B4CA C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:B4CC D0 E9        BNE $B4B7                       ; / Check for end of the object (except bottom tile)
$0D:B4CE BF 9C B4 0D  LDA.L $B49C,X                   ; \
$0D:B4D2 4C FE B4     JMP.W $B4FE                     ; / Add bottom tile


;A subroutine the vertical net edge uses

;;; $B4D5..B4D7: Map16 tiles: net edge merge (top helper) ;;;
;; Replacement tiles when overlapping an existing net edge: $07,$09 over a top edge, $1A,$19 over a bottom
;;     edge.
$0D:B4D5              .db $07,$09                     ; New tiles if it's on a top edge
$0D:B4D7              .db $1A,$19                     ; New tiles if it's on a bottom edge


;;; $B4D9: Net edge: merge top tile with existing tile ;;;
;; Writes [A] unless the tile already at the pointer is $08 (net top edge) or $0E (net bottom edge), in which
;;     case a junction tile from the table is used.
;; Called by:
;;     $0D:B4B1: Level object: net vertical edge
$0D:B4D9 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; Preserve tile
$0D:B4DB B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; Load tile we're on
$0D:B4DD C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$0D:B4DF D0 07        BNE $B4E8                       ; / Check if we're on a top edge
$0D:B4E1 BF D5 B4 0D  LDA.L $B4D5,X                   ; \
$0D:B4E5 4C F0 B4     JMP.W $B4F0                     ; / Change to new tile

$0D:B4E8 C9 0E        CMP.B #$0E                      ; \
$0D:B4EA D0 06        BNE $B4F2                       ; / Check if we're on a bottom edge
$0D:B4EC BF D7 B4 0D  LDA.L $B4D7,X                   ; \
$0D:B4F0 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / Change to new tile
$0D:B4F2 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B4F5 A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; } Add tile
$0D:B4F7 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:B4F9 60           RTS                             ; Return


;More vertical net edge stuff

;;; $B4FA..B4FC: Map16 tiles: net edge merge (bottom helper) ;;;
;; Replacement tiles over a bottom edge: $0D,$0F; over a top edge: $1C,$1B.
$0D:B4FA              .db $0D,$0F                     ; New tiles if it's on a bottom edge
$0D:B4FC              .db $1C,$1B                     ; New tiles if it's on a top edge


;;; $B4FE: Net edge: merge bottom tile; bone/pipe/log objects ;;;
;; Merge helper for the last tile of the vertical net edge, followed by the vertical (tiles $53-$55) and
;;     horizontal (tiles $56-$58) bone/pipe/log objects.
;; Called by:
;;     $0D:B4D2: Level object: net vertical edge
$0D:B4FE 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; Preserve tile
$0D:B500 B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; Load tile we're on
$0D:B502 C9 0E        CMP.B #$0E                      ; \
$0D:B504 D0 07        BNE $B50D                       ; / Check if we're on a bottom edge
$0D:B506 BF FA B4 0D  LDA.L $B4FA,X                   ; \
$0D:B50A 4C 15 B5     JMP.W $B515                     ; / Change to new tile

$0D:B50D C9 08        CMP.B #$08                      ; \
$0D:B50F D0 06        BNE $B517                       ; / Check if we're on a top edge
$0D:B511 BF FC B4 0D  LDA.L $B4FC,X                   ; \
$0D:B515 85 0C        STA $0C                         ; / Change to new tile
$0D:B517 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B51A A5 0C        LDA $0C                         ; } Add tile
$0D:B51C 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:B51E 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Vertical bone/pipe/log
$0D:B51F A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Position
$0D:B521 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B523 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$0D:B525 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B526 4A           LSR                             ; } Height
$0D:B527 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B528 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B529 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:B52A 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B52D A9 53        LDA.B #$53                      ; } Add top tile
$0D:B52F 4C 37 B5     JMP.W $B537                     ; /

$0D:B532 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B535 A9 54        LDA.B #$54                      ; } Add middle tiles
$0D:B537 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:B539 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move pointer downwards
$0D:B53C CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:B53D D0 F3        BNE $B532                       ; / Check for end of the object
$0D:B53F 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B542 A9 55        LDA.B #$55                      ; } Add bottom tiles
$0D:B544 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /

;Horizontal bone/pipe/log
$0D:B547 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Position
$0D:B549 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B54B 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Width
$0D:B54D AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:B54E 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B551 A9 56        LDA.B #$56                      ; } Add left tile
$0D:B553 4C 5B B5     JMP.W $B55B                     ; /

$0D:B556 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B559 A9 57        LDA.B #$57                      ; } Add middle tiles
$0D:B55B 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /

$0D:B561 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B564 A9 58        LDA.B #$58                      ; } Add right tile
$0D:B566 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /

;This is the Cloud Fringe objects.

;;; $B569..B569: Map16 tiles: cloud fringe blocks ;;;
$0D:B569              .db $91,$92,$96,$97,$9A,$9B,$9F,$A0 ; Cloud fringe tiles (objects $68-$6F): $91 $92 $96 $97 $9A $9B $9F $A0


;;; $B571: Level object: single cloud fringe block ;;;
;; Places one tile from the table for objects $68-$6F.
$0D:B571 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] (position)
$0D:B573 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; A = [$59] (object number $68-$6F)

$0D:B576 E9 68        SBC.B #$68                      ; |
$0D:B578 AA           TAX                             ; / X = object number - $68 (cloud fringe tile index)
$0D:B579 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B57C BF 69 B5 0D  LDA.L $B569,X                   ; } Add block

;Yellow switch block
$0D:B583 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: yellow switch block

;Green switch block (most of this is shared by both of them, though)

$0D:B59E 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B5A1 BF 87 B5 0D  LDA.L $B587,X                   ; } Add solid block
$0D:B5A5 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:B5A7 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Bushes 1 through 5

;;; $B5A8..B5B2: Map16 tiles: bushes (left/middle/right) ;;;
;; Left, middle and right tiles for bush types 0-4.
$0D:B5A8              .db $73,$7A,$85,$88,$C3         ; Left tiles, bush types 0-4: $73 $7A $85 $88 $C3
$0D:B5AD              .db $74,$7B,$86,$89,$C3         ; Middle tiles, bush types 0-4
$0D:B5B2              .db $79,$80,$87,$8E,$C3         ; Right tiles, bush types 0-4


;;; $B5B7: Level object: bushes 1-5 (and switch blocks) ;;;
;; Contains the yellow/green switch block objects (outline tile if unpressed, solid tile if pressed, tiles
;;     $6A/$6B), then draws a bush of the chosen type: left tile, middle tiles, right tile.
$0D:B5B7 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Position
$0D:B5B9 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B5BB 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Width
$0D:B5BD 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:B5BF A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B5C1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B5C2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B5C3 4A           LSR                             ; } Type
$0D:B5C4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B5C5 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:B5C6 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B5C9 BF A8 B5 0D  LDA.L $B5A8,X                   ; } Add left tile
$0D:B5CD 4C D7 B5     JMP.W $B5D7                     ; /

$0D:B5D0 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B5D3 BF AD B5 0D  LDA.L $B5AD,X                   ; } Add middle tiles
$0D:B5D7 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:B5DA C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:B5DC D0 F2        BNE $B5D0                       ; / Check for end of the object
$0D:B5DE 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B5E1 BF B2 B5 0D  LDA.L $B5B2,X                   ; } Add right tile
$0D:B5E5 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:B5E7 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Arch ledge

;;; $B5E8..B5FD: Map16 tiles: arch ledge ;;;
;; Four rows of 7 bytes: left (3 tiles), middle (3 tiles, repeated), right (1 tile). Row 0 is the top surface.
$0D:B5E8              .db $07,$0A,$0A,$08,$0A,$0A,$09 ; Row 0 tiles: left 3 ($07,$0A,$0A), middle 3 ($08,$0A,$0A), right ($09)
$0D:B5EF              .db $81,$82,$83,$81,$82,$83,$81 ; Row 1 tiles: left 3, middle 3, right
$0D:B5F6              .db $81,$25,$84,$81,$25,$84,$81 ; Row 2 tiles: left 3, middle 3, right
$0D:B5FD              .db $81,$25,$84,$81,$25,$84,$81 ; Row 3 tiles: left 3, middle 3, right


;;; $B604: Level object: arch ledge ;;;
;; Draws 4 rows using the table above, repeating the 3-tile middle pattern width times; one routine per map16
;;     page variant.
$0D:B604 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B606 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } Width
$0D:B608 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:B60A A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$0D:B60C 85 03        STA $03                         ; / Height
$0D:B60E A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into arch ledge tile table
$0D:B610 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Preserve pointer
$0D:B613 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Position
$0D:B615 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:B617 85 02        STA $02                         ; / Reload width
$0D:B619 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:B61B 85 01        STA $01                         ; / Number of tiles in left area
$0D:B61D 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B620 BF E8 B5 0D  LDA.L $B5E8,X                   ; } Add tile
$0D:B624 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:B627 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:B628 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; } Check for end of the left area
$0D:B62A 10 F1        BPL $B61D                       ; /
$0D:B62C C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$0D:B62E F0 22        BEQ $B652                       ; / Check if it has a middle area
$0D:B630 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B633 BF E8 B5 0D  LDA.L $B5E8,X                   ; |
$0D:B637 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |
$0D:B63A 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; |
$0D:B63D BF E9 B5 0D  LDA.L $B5E8+1,X                 ; } Add middle tiles
$0D:B641 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |
$0D:B644 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; |
$0D:B647 BF EA B5 0D  LDA.L $B5E8+2,X                 ; |
$0D:B64B 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:B64E C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$0D:B650 D0 DE        BNE $B630                       ; / Check if we need more middle tiles
$0D:B652 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:B653 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:B654 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; } Update index to table
$0D:B656 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:B657 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B65A BF E8 B5 0D  LDA.L $B5E8,X                   ; } Add right tile
$0D:B65E 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:B661 4C B2 B6     JMP.W $B6B2                     ; Go to loop to add the lower tiles

$0D:B664 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Position
$0D:B666 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:B668 85 02        STA $02                         ; / Reload width
$0D:B66A A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:B66C 85 01        STA $01                         ; / Number of tiles in left area
$0D:B66E 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B671 BF E8 B5 0D  LDA.L $B5E8,X                   ; } Add left tiles
$0D:B675 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:B678 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:B679 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; } Check if we need more left tiles
$0D:B67B 10 F1        BPL $B66E                       ; /
$0D:B67D C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$0D:B67F F0 22        BEQ $B6A3                       ; / Check if it has a middle area
$0D:B681 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B684 BF E8 B5 0D  LDA.L $B5E8,X                   ; |
$0D:B688 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |
$0D:B68B 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; |
$0D:B68E BF E9 B5 0D  LDA.L $B5E8+1,X                 ; } Add middle tiles
$0D:B692 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |

$0D:B6A3 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:B6A4 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:B6A5 69 03        ADC.B #$03                      ; } Update index to table
$0D:B6A7 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:B6A8 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \

$0D:B6AF 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:B6B2 E8           INX                             ; Skip to next row of the table
$0D:B6B3 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Reload pointer
$0D:B6B6 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move pointer down
$0D:B6B9 C6 03        DEC $03                         ; \
$0D:B6BB 30 03        BMI $B6C0                       ; } Check for end of the object
$0D:B6BD 4C 64 B6     JMP.W $B664                     ; /

$0D:B6C0 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0D:B6CB A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \

$0D:B6CE 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B6CF 4A           LSR                             ; } Type

$0D:B731              .db $C7,$EC,$ED,$C6             ; Diagonal pipe tile row, 4 tiles: $C7 $EC $ED $C6
$0D:B735              .db $C7,$EE,$59,$5A,$EF         ; Diagonal pipe tile row, 5 tiles: $C7 $EE $59 $5A $EF

;;; $B73F: Diagonal pipe, diagonal ledges, switch blocks ;;;
;; Level object draw routines (standard objects, Map16 tile writers). $57 = position index into the level
;;     Map16 buffer, [$59] = size byte (width/height nibbles).
;; $B73F: right-facing diagonal pipe (rows grow two tiles wider, drawn down-left, tiles from
;;     $B72F, bottom cap $1EB).
;; $B7AA / $B863: left- and right-facing diagonal ledges (slope, slope assist, dirt and diagonal-
;;     line tiles, picked by $B84E / $ABFD depending on the tile underneath).
;; $B916 / $B91E: blue / red switch blocks (solid tile $06C/$06D until the switch palace switch is
;;     pressed, then $16C/$16D).
;; Tile numbers: Map16 page 1 ($1xx) is set with Sta1To6ePointer, page 0 with StzTo6ePointer. Includes the
;;     helper $B84E.
$0D:B73F A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = object position index [$57]
$0D:B741 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B743 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B744 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B745 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B746 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B747 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = size = high nibble of [$59] (number of extra rows)
$0D:B749 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0D:B74B 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = 1: first row has 2 tiles (count - 1)
$0D:B74D A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into the diagonal pipe tile table $B72F
$0D:B74F 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the start-of-row pointer in $04/$05
$0D:B752 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$0D:B754 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = tiles left in this row
$0D:B756 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B759 BF 2F B7 0D  LDA.L $B72F,X                   ; |
$0D:B75D 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Map16 page 1, tile [DATA_0DB72F+X], step one tile right
$0D:B760 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:B761 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; |
$0D:B763 10 F1        BPL $B756                       ; / Next table entry; repeat until the row is done
$0D:B765 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:B768 20 92 A9     JSR.W $A992                     ; Start of next row: one tile down and one tile left
$0D:B76B E6 01        INC $01                         ; \
$0D:B76D E6 01        INC $01                         ; / Next row is two tiles wider
$0D:B76F C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:B771 30 2C        BMI $B79F                       ; / One row less to go; finish with the bottom tile when none are left
$0D:B773 E0 06        CPX.B #$06                      ; \
$0D:B775 D0 DB        BNE $B752                       ; / Keep growing until table index 6 is reached (rows of 2 and 4 tiles done)
$0D:B777 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; Widest rows are 5 tiles, not 6
$0D:B779 A5 01        LDA $01                         ; \
$0D:B77B 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = tiles left in this row (widest rows)
$0D:B77D 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B780 BF 2F B7 0D  LDA.L $B72F,X                   ; |
$0D:B784 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Map16 page 1, tile [DATA_0DB72F+X], step one tile right
$0D:B787 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:B788 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; |
$0D:B78A 10 F1        BPL $B77D                       ; / Next table entry; repeat until the row is done
$0D:B78C 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:B78F 20 92 A9     JSR.W $A992                     ; Start of next row: one tile down and one tile left
$0D:B792 E0 10        CPX.B #$10                      ; \
$0D:B794 D0 05        BNE $B79B                       ; / Past the end of the tile table (index $10)?
$0D:B796 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:B797 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:B798 E9 05        SBC.B #$05                      ; |
$0D:B79A AA           TAX                             ; / Yes: X -= 5 so the last 5-tile row (index 11) is repeated
$0D:B79B C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:B79D 10 DA        BPL $B779                       ; / Next row until the requested rows are done
$0D:B79F 20 5D A9     JSR.W $A95D                     ; Move down one tile below the last row
$0D:B7A2 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B7A5 A9 EB        LDA.B #$EB                      ; |
$0D:B7A7 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Map16 page 1, bottom tile $1EB
$0D:B7A9 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Left facing diagonal ledge
$0D:B7AA A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = object position index [$57]

$0D:B7DF 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B7E2 A9 E2        LDA.B #$E2                      ; |

$0D:B7E7 4C F2 B7     JMP.W $B7F2                     ; Skip over the dirt loop entry

$0D:B7EF 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Page 0 tile $03F (dirt), step right

$0D:B7F5 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B7F8 A9 A6        LDA.B #$A6                      ; |
$0D:B7FA 20 4E B8     JSR.W $B84E                     ; / Right end of the row: tile $0A6 with the diagonal line ($B84E)
$0D:B7FD 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:B800 20 92 A9     JSR.W $A992                     ; Start of next row: one tile down and one tile left
$0D:B803 E6 01        INC $01                         ; \
$0D:B805 E6 01        INC $01                         ; / Next row is two tiles wider
$0D:B807 A6 01        LDX $01                         ; X = new row width
$0D:B809 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$0D:B80B 10 C9        BPL $B7D6                       ; / Repeat for all rows of the slope
$0D:B80D 20 5D A9     JSR.W $A95D                     ; Move down one tile (start of the lower part)
$0D:B810 84 57        STY $57                         ; \
$0D:B812 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; / Save new position in $57 and the pointer in $04/$05
$0D:B815 CA           DEX                             ; Width - 1
$0D:B816 86 01        STX $01                         ; $01 = new width
$0D:B818 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B81B A9 F7        LDA.B #$F7                      ; |
$0D:B81D 20 FD AB     JSR.W $ABFD                     ; / Lower leftmost tile $1F7 (page 1), changed if on special tiles
$0D:B820 4C 36 B8     JMP.W $B836                     ; Go fill in the rest of the row

$0D:B823 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B826 A9 A3        LDA.B #$A3                      ; |
$0D:B828 20 4E B8     JSR.W $B84E                     ; / Left end of the row: tile $0A3 with the diagonal line ($B84E)
$0D:B82B 4C 36 B8     JMP.W $B836                     ; Go fill in the rest of the row

$0D:B82E 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B831 A9 3F        LDA.B #$3F                      ; |
$0D:B833 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Ground tile $03F (page 0), step right
$0D:B836 CA           DEX                             ; Width - 1
$0D:B837 D0 F5        BNE $B82E                       ; Repeat while more ground tiles are needed
$0D:B839 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B83C A9 A6        LDA.B #$A6                      ; |
$0D:B83E 20 4E B8     JSR.W $B84E                     ; / Right end of the row: tile $0A6 with the diagonal line ($B84E)
$0D:B841 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:B844 20 B4 A9     JSR.W $A9B4                     ; Start of next row: one tile down and one tile right
$0D:B847 A6 01        LDX $01                         ; X = row width
$0D:B849 C6 03        DEC $03                         ; \
$0D:B84B 10 D6        BPL $B823                       ; / Repeat for the width of the ledge ($03)

;Add tile for the diagonal ledges and check if we need to care about those black lines
$0D:B84E 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; Tile to add (A) = $0F
$0D:B850 B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; Tile already on the map at this position
$0D:B852 C9 25        CMP.B #$25                      ; \

$0D:B875 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; \

$0D:B879 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the start-of-row pointer in $04/$05
$0D:B87C AD 0D AA     LDA.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; Dummy read of $AA0D (A is reloaded next); probably a mangled JSR to the page-0 setter

$0D:B906 20 4E B8     JSR.W $B84E                     ; / Right end of the row: tile $0AC with the diagonal line
$0D:B909 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:B90C 20 92 A9     JSR.W $A992                     ; Start of next row: one tile down and one tile left
$0D:B90F A6 01        LDX $01                         ; X = row width
$0D:B911 C6 03        DEC $03                         ; \
$0D:B913 10 D6        BPL $B8EB                       ; / Repeat for the height of the ledge ($03)
$0D:B915 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Blue switch blocks
$0D:B916 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: blue switch block
$0D:B918 F0 06        BEQ $B920                       ; Always taken (X = 0)

$0D:B91A              .db $6C,$6D                     ; Tile when the switch has not been pressed: $06C blue, $06D red (page 0)
$0D:B91C              .db $6C,$6D                     ; Tile when the switch has been pressed: $16C blue, $16D red (page 1)


;Red switch blocks
$0D:B91E A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: red switch block
$0D:B920 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = object position index [$57]
$0D:B922 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B924 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:B926 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = width = low nibble of [$59]
$0D:B928 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B92A 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B92B 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B92C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B92D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B92E 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = height = high nibble of [$59]
$0D:B930 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:B932 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = tiles left in this row
$0D:B934 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the start-of-row pointer in $04/$05
$0D:B937 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B93A BF 1A B9 0D  LDA.L $B91A,X                   ; |
$0D:B93E 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / Page 0; $0F = unpressed tile (DATA_0DB91A+X)
$0D:B940 BD 29 1F     LDA.W $1F29,X                   ; \
$0D:B943 F0 09        BEQ $B94E                       ; / Has this colour of switch palace switch been pressed? ([$1F29+X])
$0D:B945 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B948 BF 1C B9 0D  LDA.L $B91C,X                   ; |
$0D:B94C 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / Yes: page 1 and $0F = pressed tile (DATA_0DB91C+X)
$0D:B94E A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$0D:B950 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Add the tile and step right
$0D:B953 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$0D:B955 10 E0        BPL $B937                       ; / Repeat to the end of the row
$0D:B957 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:B95A 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:B95D C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:B95F 10 CF        BPL $B930                       ; / Repeat for all rows
$0D:B961 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Small tree trunk (forest)

;;; $B962..B964: Tile table: small tree trunk ;;;
;; Top tiles $0BD/$0BF and bottom tiles $0BE/$0C0 by trunk type.
$0D:B962              .db $BD,$BF                     ; Small tree trunk top tiles by type: $0BD, $0BF
$0D:B964              .db $BE,$C0                     ; Small tree trunk bottom tiles by type: $0BE, $0C0 (16x32 object, repeats vertically)


;;; $B966: Forest tree trunks and ledge ;;;
;; $B966: small tree trunk (type 0/1, 16x32 repeating, tile merging via $B997).
;; $B9C0: large tree trunk ($0B9/$0BA, $0BB/$0BC rows; $10B/$10C when starting on a ledge top).
;; $BA0A: forest ledge (top row of $10E then rows of $0B8).
$0D:B966 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = object position index [$57]
$0D:B968 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B96A 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:B96C AA           TAX                             ; / X = trunk type = low nibble of [$59]
$0D:B96D A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B96F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B970 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B971 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B972 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B973 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = height = high nibble of [$59]
$0D:B975 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B978 BF 62 B9 0D  LDA.L $B962,X                   ; |
$0D:B97C 20 97 B9     JSR.W $B997                     ; / Page 0; upper tile (DATA_0DB962+X), merged with the tile below via $B997
$0D:B97F 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one tile
$0D:B982 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:B984 30 10        BMI $B996                       ; / Finished when the height counter runs out
$0D:B986 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B989 BF 64 B9 0D  LDA.L $B964,X                   ; |
$0D:B98D 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Page 0; lower tile (DATA_0DB964+X) written directly
$0D:B98F 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one tile
$0D:B992 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:B994 10 DF        BPL $B975                       ; / Repeat for the height of the object
$0D:B996 60           RTS                             ; Return

;Add tile for small tree trunk and update tile number if it's on something useful
$0D:B997 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; $0F = tile to add
$0D:B999 E0 01        CPX.B #$01                      ; \
$0D:B99B D0 11        BNE $B9AE                       ; / Trunk type 1? (otherwise go to type 0 handling)
$0D:B99D B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; Tile already on the map here
$0D:B99F C9 B1        CMP.B #$B1                      ; \
$0D:B9A1 F0 04        BEQ $B9A7                       ; |
$0D:B9A3 C9 B6        CMP.B #$B6                      ; |
$0D:B9A5 D0 14        BNE $B9BB                       ; / If it is tile $0B1 or $0B6 ...
$0D:B9A7 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; \
$0D:B9A9 E6 0F        INC $0F                         ; / ... use that tile + 1 ($0B2 / $0B7)
$0D:B9AB 4C BB B9     JMP.W $B9BB                     ; Write the tile

$0D:B9AE B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; Tile already on the map here
$0D:B9B0 C9 0E        CMP.B #$0E                      ; \
$0D:B9B2 D0 07        BNE $B9BB                       ; / Only act if it is tile $10E (top of a forest ledge)
$0D:B9B4 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B9B7 A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; |
$0D:B9B9 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / Page 1 and tile $10D instead
$0D:B9BB A5 0F        LDA $0F                         ; \
$0D:B9BD 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Write the tile
$0D:B9BF 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Large tree trunk (forest)
$0D:B9C0 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = object position index [$57]
$0D:B9C2 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:B9C4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B9C5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B9C6 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B9C7 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:B9C8 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = height = high nibble of [$59] (width bits are unused)
$0D:B9CA 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the start-of-row pointer in $04/$05
$0D:B9CD A2 B9        LDX.B #$B9                      ; \
$0D:B9CF 20 F6 B9     JSR.W $B9F6                     ; / Add the $0B9/$0BA pair ($B9F6)
$0D:B9D2 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:B9D5 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:B9D8 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:B9DA 30 19        BMI $B9F5                       ; / Finished when the height counter runs out
$0D:B9DC 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B9DF A9 BB        LDA.B #$BB                      ; |
$0D:B9E1 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Page 0 tile $0BB, step right
$0D:B9E4 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:B9E7 A9 BC        LDA.B #$BC                      ; |
$0D:B9E9 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Page 0 tile $0BC
$0D:B9EB 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:B9EE 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:B9F1 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:B9F3 10 D5        BPL $B9CA                       ; / Repeat for the height of the object
$0D:B9F5 60           RTS                             ; Return

;Add one of the rows for the large tree trunk and check if we're on a ledge
$0D:B9F6 B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; Tile already on the map here
$0D:B9F8 C9 0E        CMP.B #$0E                      ; \
$0D:B9FA D0 05        BNE $BA01                       ; / Standing on tile $10E (forest ledge top)?
$0D:B9FC 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:B9FF A2 0B        LDX.B #$0B                      ; / Yes: page 1 and use tiles $10B/$10C instead
$0D:BA01 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:BA02 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Add tile X and step right
$0D:BA05 E8           INX                             ; Next tile number
$0D:BA06 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:BA07 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Add tile X + 1
$0D:BA09 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Ledge (forest)
$0D:BA0A A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = object position index [$57]
$0D:BA0C A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:BA0E 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:BA10 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0D:BA12 AA           TAX                             ; / $00 = X = width = low nibble of [$59]
$0D:BA13 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:BA15 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BA16 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BA17 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BA18 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BA19 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = height = high nibble of [$59]
$0D:BA1B 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the start-of-row pointer in $04/$05
$0D:BA1E 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:BA21 A9 0E        LDA.B #$0E                      ; |
$0D:BA23 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Top row: page 1 tile $10E, step right
$0D:BA26 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:BA27 10 F5        BPL $BA1E                       ; / Repeat to the end of the row
$0D:BA29 4C 37 BA     JMP.W $BA37                     ; Go to the next row

$0D:BA2C 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:BA2F A9 B8        LDA.B #$B8                      ; |
$0D:BA31 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Dirt rows: page 0 tile $0B8, step right
$0D:BA34 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:BA35 10 F5        BPL $BA2C                       ; / Repeat to the end of the row
$0D:BA37 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:BA3A 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:BA3D A6 00        LDX $00                         ; X = width
$0D:BA3F C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:BA41 10 E9        BPL $BA2C                       ; / Repeat for all rows
$0D:BA43 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Left/right and top edge (forest)

;;; $BA44..BA48: Tile table: forest left/right/top edge ;;;
;; Top tiles $5F,$5E,$10,$0F and bottom tiles $60,$5D,$C5,$C4 by edge type.
$0D:BA44              .db $5F,$5E,$10,$0F             ; Top tiles by type: $15F, $15E (non-solid edges), $110, $10F (solid edges)
$0D:BA48              .db $60,$5D,$C5,$C4             ; Lower tiles by type: $160, $15D, $0C5, $0C4


;;; $BA4C: Forest left/right and top edge object ;;;
;; Draws a vertical column: a top tile (DATA_0DBA44+type) and then lower tiles (DATA_0DBA48+type) for the
;;     given height.
;; Parameters: [$59] low nibble = edge type (0-3), high nibble = height.
$0D:BA4C A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = object position index [$57]
$0D:BA4E A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:BA50 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:BA52 AA           TAX                             ; / X = edge type = low nibble of [$59]
$0D:BA53 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:BA55 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BA56 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BA57 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BA58 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BA59 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = height = high nibble of [$59]
$0D:BA5B 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:BA5E BF 44 BA 0D  LDA.L $BA44,X                   ; |
$0D:BA62 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Top tile: page 1, tile DATA_0DBA44+X
$0D:BA64 4C 74 BA     JMP.W $BA74                     ; Go on with the rest of the column

$0D:BA67 E0 02        CPX.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:BA69 10 03        BPL $BA6E                       ; / Types 2 and 3 (solid left/right edge) keep the existing page byte
$0D:BA6B 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Types 0 and 1: set Map16 page 1
$0D:BA6E BF 48 BA 0D  LDA.L $BA48,X                   ; \
$0D:BA72 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Lower tile: DATA_0DBA48+X
$0D:BA74 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one tile
$0D:BA77 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:BA79 10 EC        BPL $BA67                       ; / Repeat for the height of the object
$0D:BA7B 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Forest tree top (worst coding I've ever seen)

;;; $BA7C..BACC: Data: forest tree top canopy ;;;
;; 16x6 tile pattern, one 16-byte row per line. $B4 = leaves, $B1/$B3/$B5/$B6 = edge pieces, $25 = blank.
$0D:BA7C              .db $B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4 ; Tree top canopy, row 0 of 6 (16 tiles; $B4 = leaves, $25 = blank)
$0D:BA8C              .db $B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4 ; Tree top canopy, row 1 of 6 (16 tiles; $B4 = leaves, $25 = blank)
$0D:BA9C              .db $B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B5,$B3,$B5,$B3 ; Tree top canopy, row 2 of 6 (16 tiles; $B4 = leaves, $25 = blank)
$0D:BAAC              .db $B3,$B4,$B4,$B5,$B3,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B4,$B5,$B3,$B5,$B6,$B1,$B6,$B1 ; Tree top canopy, row 3 of 6 (16 tiles; $B4 = leaves, $25 = blank)
$0D:BABC              .db $B1,$B3,$B5,$B6,$B1,$B3,$B5,$B3,$B5,$B6,$B1,$B6,$25,$25,$25,$25 ; Tree top canopy, row 4 of 6 (16 tiles; $B4 = leaves, $25 = blank)
$0D:BACC              .db $25,$B1,$B6,$25,$25,$B1,$B6,$B1,$B6,$25,$25,$25,$25,$25,$25,$25 ; Tree top canopy, row 5 of 6 (16 tiles; $B4 = leaves, $25 = blank)


;;; $BADC: Forest tree top and ice blue pipe ;;;
;; $BADC: forest tree top. Copies the 16x6 canopy table once per screen, moving +$1B0 (next screen)
;;     between copies. Parameters: [$59] = number of extra screens.
;; $BB2C: ice blue vertical pipe ($161/$162 top, $163/$164 middle rows). Parameters: [$59] high nibble =
;;     middle rows.
;; $BB63: ice blue turn tiles, reuses the generic block routine $A8C3 with X = $0E.
$0D:BADC A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:BADE 85 0F        STA $0F                         ; / $0F = number of screens = [$59]
$0D:BAE0 A5 57        LDA $57                         ; \
$0D:BAE2 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; |
$0D:BAE4 A8           TAY                             ; / $0E = Y = starting position index [$57]
$0D:BAE5 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into the canopy table
$0D:BAE7 A9 05        LDA.B #$05                      ; \
$0D:BAE9 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = 5: six rows
$0D:BAEB A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$0D:BAED 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = 15: sixteen tiles per row (one screen wide)
$0D:BAEF 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the start-of-row pointer in $04/$05
$0D:BAF2 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:BAF4 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = tiles left in this row
$0D:BAF6 BF 7C BA 0D  LDA.L $BA7C,X                   ; \
$0D:BAFA 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Write tile [DATA_0DBA7C+X], step right (page byte is not changed)
$0D:BAFD E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:BAFE C6 02        DEC $02                         ; |
$0D:BB00 10 F4        BPL $BAF6                       ; / Next table entry; repeat to the end of the row
$0D:BB02 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:BB05 A5 0E        LDA $0E                         ; \
$0D:BB07 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:BB08 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0D:BB0A 85 0E        STA $0E                         ; |
$0D:BB0C A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:BB0D 90 03        BCC $BB12                       ; |
$0D:BB0F 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; / $0E += $10 and Y = $0E: one tile down (and fix the pointer on carry)
$0D:BB12 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:BB14 10 DC        BPL $BAF2                       ; / Repeat for all six rows
$0D:BB16 A5 6B        LDA $6B                         ; \
$0D:BB18 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:BB19 69 B0        ADC.B #$B0                      ; |
$0D:BB1B 85 6B        STA $6B                         ; |
$0D:BB1D 85 6E        STA $6E                         ; |
$0D:BB1F A5 6C        LDA $6C                         ; |
$0D:BB21 69 00        ADC.B #$00                      ; |
$0D:BB23 85 6C        STA $6C                         ; |
$0D:BB25 85 6F        STA $6F                         ; / Pointer += $1B0: next screen (carry into the high byte is needed)
$0D:BB27 C6 0F        DEC $0F                         ; \
$0D:BB29 10 B5        BPL $BAE0                       ; / Repeat for all screens
$0D:BB2B 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Ice blue vertical pipe
$0D:BB2C A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = object position index [$57]
$0D:BB2E A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:BB30 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BB31 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BB32 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BB33 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:BB34 AA           TAX                             ; / X = height = high nibble of [$59]
$0D:BB35 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the start-of-row pointer in $04/$05
$0D:BB38 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:BB3B A9 61        LDA.B #$61                      ; |
$0D:BB3D 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Top left tile: page 1 tile $161, step right
$0D:BB40 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:BB43 A9 62        LDA.B #$62                      ; |
$0D:BB45 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Top right tile: page 1 tile $162
$0D:BB47 4C 59 BB     JMP.W $BB59                     ; Go to the next row

$0D:BB4A 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:BB4D A9 63        LDA.B #$63                      ; |
$0D:BB4F 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Middle left tile: page 1 tile $163, step right
$0D:BB52 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:BB55 A9 64        LDA.B #$64                      ; |
$0D:BB57 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Middle right tile: page 1 tile $164
$0D:BB59 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:BB5C 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:BB5F CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:BB60 10 E8        BPL $BB4A                       ; / Repeat for the height of the pipe

;Ice blue turn tiles
$0D:BB63 A2 0E        LDX.B #$0E                      ; \
$0D:BB65 4C C3 A8     JMP.W $A8C3                     ; / X = $0E: use the generic single-tile object routine ($A8C3) with entry $0E (ice blue turn blocks)


;;; $BB68..C188: Castle tileset Map16 tile definitions ;;;
;; Starts with $FF freespace up to $0DBBFF. From $0DBC00 are the tileset-specific Map16 definitions used by
;;     tileset 1 (castle, TilesetMAP16Loc),
;; 8 bytes per tile = 4 x (chr, prop) in order TL, BL, TR, BR (left column first; verified against flipped-
;;     pair rows). prop = YXPCCCTT.
;; Tile numbers are those where the Map16 load mask ($81BB) uses tileset-specific data: $073-$0FF,
;;     $107-$110, $153-$16D. All-zero rows are unused tiles.
$0D:BB68              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BB70              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BB78              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BB80              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BB88              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BB90              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BB98              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BBA0              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BBA8              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BBB0              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BBB8              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BBC0              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$0D:BBC8              .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF

;; Called for standard objects when the tileset is 1 (castle). Calls the draw routine for object [$5A] through
;;     the long-pointer table that follows.
$0D:C190 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; A and X, Y 8-bit
$0D:C192 A6 5A        LDX $5A                         ; X = standard object number [$5A]
$0D:C194 CA           DEX                             ; Object numbers start at 1; make the index 0-based
$0D:C195 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:C196 22 FA 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtrLong            ; / Call the draw routine from the table below (index in A)

;Conveyor end tiles

$0D:C261 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:C264 BF 57 C2 0D  LDA.L $C257,X                   ; |
$0D:C268 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Page 0; write the conveyor end tile (DATA_0DC257+X)
$0D:C26A 60           RTS                             ; Return

;; 14 rows of 9 Map16 tile numbers (page 0). $25 (blank) entries are not drawn by $C2E9.
