$0D:C274              .db $79,$7A,$7B,$79,$7A,$7B,$73,$74,$75 ; Castle entrance row 1 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C27D              .db $73,$74,$74,$74,$75,$73,$77,$77,$78 ; Castle entrance row 2 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C286              .db $76,$77,$77,$7A,$7B,$79,$7A,$7A,$7B ; Castle entrance row 3 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C28F              .db $79,$7A,$7B,$73,$74,$74,$75,$73,$74 ; Castle entrance row 4 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C298              .db $73,$75,$73,$77,$7A,$7A,$7B,$79,$7A ; Castle entrance row 5 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C2A1              .db $79,$7B,$79,$7B,$7C,$7D,$7D,$7D,$7D ; Castle entrance row 6 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C2AA              .db $25,$73,$74,$75,$7E,$7F,$7F,$7F,$7F ; Castle entrance row 7 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C2B3              .db $25,$76,$77,$78,$80,$81,$81,$81,$81 ; Castle entrance row 8 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C2BC              .db $25,$76,$77,$78,$82,$82,$82,$82,$7C ; Castle entrance row 9 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C2C5              .db $25,$79,$7A,$7B,$83,$84,$84,$85,$80 ; Castle entrance row 10 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C2CE              .db $25,$73,$74,$75,$83,$84,$84,$85,$7C ; Castle entrance row 11 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C2D7              .db $25,$76,$77,$78,$83,$84,$84,$85,$7E ; Castle entrance row 12 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)
$0D:C2E0              .db $25,$79,$7A,$7B,$83,$84,$84,$85,$80 ; Castle entrance row 13 (9 tiles, page 0; $25 = leave blank)


;;; $C2E9: Castle entrance object ;;;
;; Extended object: draws the 9x14 castle entrance from $C26B at the object position, skipping blank
;;     tiles in the first 8 columns.
$0D:C2E9 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position index [$57]
$0D:C2EB A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into the castle entrance tiles
$0D:C2ED A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$0D:C2EF 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = 8: 8 tiles drawn with the blank check, plus 1 without
$0D:C2F1 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:C2F4 BF 6B C2 0D  LDA.L $C26B,X                   ; |
$0D:C2F8 C9 25        CMP.B #$25                      ; |
$0D:C2FA F0 02        BEQ $C2FE                       ; |
$0D:C2FC 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Page 0; tile [DATA_0DC26B+X]: skipped if it is the blank tile $25
$0D:C2FE 20 5D A9     JSR.W $A95D                     ; \
$0D:C301 E8           INX                             ; / Step right one tile (no write) and go to the next table entry
$0D:C302 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:C304 D0 EB        BNE $C2F1                       ; / Repeat for the first 8 tiles of the row
$0D:C306 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:C309 BF 6B C2 0D  LDA.L $C26B,X                   ; |
$0D:C30D 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Page 0; ninth tile of the row is always written
$0D:C30F E8           INX                             ; Next table entry
$0D:C310 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:C313 E0 7E        CPX.B #$7E                      ; \
$0D:C315 D0 D6        BNE $C2ED                       ; / Repeat until all 14 rows (X = $7E) are drawn
$0D:C317 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Boss door

;;; $C318..C31C: Data: boss door tiles ;;;
;; Three rows of two tiles: $098,$099 / $09A,$09B / $09C,$09C.
$0D:C318              .db $98,$99                     ; Boss door top row tiles: $098, $099
$0D:C31A              .db $9A,$9B                     ; Boss door middle row tiles: $09A, $09B
$0D:C31C              .db $9C,$9C                     ; Boss door bottom row tiles: $09C, $09C


;;; $C31E: Boss door object ;;;
;; Extended object: draws the 2x3 boss door from $C318 at the object position.
$0D:C31E A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position index [$57]
$0D:C320 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into the boss door tiles
$0D:C322 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0D:C324 85 00        STA $00                         ; / $00 = 1: two tiles per row (count - 1)
$0D:C326 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:C328 85 01        STA $01                         ; / $01 = tiles left in this row
$0D:C32A 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:C32D BF 18 C3 0D  LDA.L $C318,X                   ; |
$0D:C331 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Page 0; tile [DATA_0DC318+X], step right
$0D:C334 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:C335 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; / Next tile
$0D:C337 10 F1        BPL $C32A                       ; Repeat to the end of the row
$0D:C339 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:C33C E0 06        CPX.B #$06                      ; \
$0D:C33E D0 E6        BNE $C326                       ; / Repeat until all 3 rows (6 tiles) are drawn
$0D:C340 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Conveyors
$0D:C341 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:C343 29 02        AND.B #$02                      ; |
$0D:C345 4A           LSR                             ; / Bit 1 of [$59] (direction) -> 0 = left, 1 = right
$0D:C346 22 FA 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtrLong            ; Run the left or right conveyor routine


;;; $C34A: Conveyor objects (left and right) (PtrsLong0DC34A) ;;;
;; $C341 picks left or right (bit 1 of [$59]); the table at $0DC34A holds the two routines.
;; $C358 (left) and $C3D8 (right) draw a triangular conveyor-topped slope: conveyor tile
;;     ($1CE-$1D1), slope assist tile ($1F3-$1F6) and dirt ($03F), one row wider per step.
;; Parameters: [$59] high nibble = rows - 1, low 2 bits = conveyor type.
$0D:C34A 58 C3 0D     .dw $C358 .db :$CODE_0DC358     ; Left-facing conveyor: $C358
$0D:C34D D8 C3 0D     .dw $C3D8 .db :$CODE_0DC3D8     ; Right-facing conveyor: $C3D8

$0D:C350              .db $CE,$D1,$CF,$D0             ; Conveyor (sloped) tiles by type: $1CE, $1D1, $1CF, $1D0 (page 1)
$0D:C354              .db $F3,$F6,$F4,$F5             ; Slope assist tiles by type: $1F3, $1F6, $1F4, $1F5 (page 1)

$0D:C358 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position index [$57]
$0D:C35A A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$0D:C35C 85 02        STA $02                         ; / $02 = 0: first row has 1 conveyor tile (count - 1)
$0D:C35E A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:C360 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; |
$0D:C362 AA           TAX                             ; / X = type = low 2 bits of [$59]

; This calls the correct code for the object if the tileset is T:2 in LM (rope)

;;; $CD90: Dispatch object for tileset 2 objects ;;;
;; Looks up the object number in [$5A] (minus 1) and jumps through the long pointer table that follows.
$0D:CD90 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; Set 8-bit A and index
$0D:CD92 A6 5A        LDX $5A                         ; X = object number [$5A]
$0D:CD94 CA           DEX                             ; X = object-1 (object 0 never occurs)
$0D:CD95 8A           TXA                             ; A = pointer table index
$0D:CD96 22 FA 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtrLong            ; Jump to the routine for this object (tileset 2 object table)


;;; $CD9A: Object pointer 01: Water (Blue) (PtrsLong0DCD9A) ;;;

;;     share a routine;

;;; $D07A: Very steep slope pointers; mushroom and log objects (PtrsLong0DD07A) ;;;

;; Very steep slopes (guide-line type chosen by [$59] >> 4), mushroom ledge, mushroom column, horizontal log

$0D:D086 AA           TAX                             ; /

$0D:D08C 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /

$0D:D092 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:D093 90 03        BCC $D098                       ; |
$0D:D095 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; /
$0D:D098 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:D09B A9 8A        LDA.B #$8A                      ; } Page 0 / low byte $8A: lower tile of the slope = Map16 $08A
$0D:D09D 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:D09F 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:D0A0 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:D0A1 69 0F        ADC.B #$0F                      ; } Y += $0F: one row down and one column left (carry bumps the pointer)
$0D:D0A3 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:D0A4 90 03        BCC $D0A9                       ; |
$0D:D0A6 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; /
$0D:D0A9 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:D0AA 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:D0AC C9 0F        CMP.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:D0AE D0 0D        BNE $D0BD                       ; |
$0D:D0B0 98           TYA                             ; |

$0D:D0B2 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; |
$0D:D0B4 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:D0B5 90 03        BCC $D0BA                       ; |

$0D:D0BA 20 D6 A9     JSR.W $A9D6                     ; /
$0D:D0BD 84 57        STY $57                         ; Save the new position in [$57]
$0D:D0BF CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:D0C0 10 C5        BPL $D087                       ; / Next step; loop until X wraps negative
$0D:D0C2 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0D:D0C3 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57]: object position in the Map16 buffer
$0D:D0C5 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:D0C7 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } X = [$59] & $0F: object size (number of steps - 1)
$0D:D0C9 AA           TAX                             ; /

$0D:D0CD A9 89        LDA.B #$89                      ; } Page 0 / low byte $89: upper tile of the slope = Map16 $089
$0D:D0CF 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:D0D1 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:D0D2 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:D0D3 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Y += $10: one row down (carry bumps the buffer pointer high byte)
$0D:D0D5 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:D0D6 90 03        BCC $D0DB                       ; |
$0D:D0D8 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; /
$0D:D0DB 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:D0DE A9 8B        LDA.B #$8B                      ; } Page 0 / low byte $8B: lower tile of the slope = Map16 $08B
$0D:D0E0 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:D0E2 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:D0E3 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:D0E4 69 10        ADC.B #$10                      ; } Y += $10: one row down (carry bumps the pointer)
$0D:D0E6 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:D0E7 90 03        BCC $D0EC                       ; |
$0D:D0E9 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; /
$0D:D0EC 98           TYA                             ; \
$0D:D0ED 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:D0EE 69 01        ADC.B #$01                      ; |
$0D:D0F0 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:D0F1 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:D0F3 D0 08        BNE $D0FD                       ; Branch if Y did not wrap to column 0
$0D:D0F5 88           DEY                             ; |
$0D:D0F6 98           TYA                             ; |
$0D:D0F7 29 F0        AND.B #$F0                      ; |
$0D:D0F9 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:D0FA 20 EF A9     JSR.W $A9EF                     ; /
$0D:D0FD 84 57        STY $57                         ; Save the new position in [$57]
$0D:D0FF CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:D100 10 C8        BPL $D0CA                       ; / Next step; loop until X wraps negative
$0D:D102 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Mushroom ledge
$0D:D103 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57]: object position
$0D:D105 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:D107 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } [$00] = [$59] & $0F: width
$0D:D109 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:D10B 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Set Map16 page 1 for the left tile
$0D:D10E A2 07        LDX.B #$07                      ; X = $07: left-end tile $107 (cap sticking out on the left)
$0D:D110 B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; \
$0D:D112 C9 73        CMP.B #$73                      ; |
$0D:D114 30 06        BMI $D11C                       ; } Read the tile already there: if it is $073-$075 (a mushroom column below), use the alternate
$0D:D116 C9 76        CMP.B #$76                      ; |
$0D:D118 10 02        BPL $D11C                       ; /
$0D:D11A A2 0A        LDX.B #$0A                      ; X = $0A: left-end tile $10A when it sits on a column

$0D:D120 4C 2B D1     JMP.W $D12B                     ; Skip the middle-tile loop on the first pass

$0D:D123 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Set Map16 page 1 for a middle tile
$0D:D126 A9 08        LDA.B #$08                      ; \
$0D:D128 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Write middle tile $108, advance one column
$0D:D12B C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:D12D D0 F4        BNE $D123                       ; / Loop for the remaining middle tiles (width)
$0D:D12F 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Set Map16 page 1 for the right tile
$0D:D132 A2 09        LDX.B #$09                      ; X = $09: right-end tile $109
$0D:D134 B7 6B        LDA [$6B],Y                     ; \
$0D:D136 C9 73        CMP.B #$73                      ; |
$0D:D138 30 06        BMI $D140                       ; } Read the tile already there: if it is $073-$075 (a mushroom column below), use the alternate
$0D:D13A C9 76        CMP.B #$76                      ; |
$0D:D13C 10 02        BPL $D140                       ; /
$0D:D13E A2 0B        LDX.B #$0B                      ; X = $0B: right-end tile $10B when it sits on a column
$0D:D140 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:D141 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Write tile $1xx = [X] and advance one column
$0D:D144 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Mushroom column
$0D:D145 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57]: object position
$0D:D147 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:D149 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } [$00] = [$59] & $0F: width
$0D:D14B 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:D14D A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:D14F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:D150 4A           LSR                             ; } [$01] = [$59] >> 4: height
$0D:D151 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:D152 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:D153 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$0D:D155 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the buffer pointer so each row can restart at the left
$0D:D158 A6 00        LDX $00                         ; X = width
$0D:D15A 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:D15D A9 73        LDA.B #$73                      ; } Page 0 / tile $073: left tile of the row
$0D:D15F 4C 67 D1     JMP.W $D167                     ; /

$0D:D162 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:D165 A9 74        LDA.B #$74                      ; } Page 0 / tile $074: middle tile of the row (advance one column)
$0D:D167 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:D16A CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:D16B D0 F5        BNE $D162                       ; / Loop for all middle tiles
$0D:D16D 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:D170 A9 75        LDA.B #$75                      ; } Page 0 / tile $075: right tile of the row
$0D:D172 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /

$0D:D178 A6 00        LDX $00                         ; X = width again
$0D:D17A 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:D17D C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \

;Horizontal log

$0D:D186 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } X = [$59] & $0F: width

$0D:D191 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \

;;; $D1D9: Object: plants on columns ;;;
;; Draws a plant (type [$59] & $0F) and, if the height nibble is non-zero, a column below it built from the
;;     6-byte table at $0DD1D3.
$0D:D1D9 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57]: object position
$0D:D1DB A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:D1DD 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } X = [$59] & $0F: plant type
$0D:D1DF AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:D1E0 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:D1E2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:D1E3 4A           LSR                             ; } [$00] = [$59] >> 4: height (0 = just the plant)
$0D:D1E4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:D1E5 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:D1E6 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:D1E8 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the buffer pointer
$0D:D1EB 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \

$0D:D1F5 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \

$0D:D1FE C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \

$0D:D202 4C 4B D2     JMP.W $D24B                     ; No column: finish

$0D:D205 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the saved pointer (left column)
$0D:D208 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:D20B 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:D20E A9 5F        LDA.B #$5F                      ; } Page 1 / tile $15F: top left of the column

$0D:D218 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /

$0D:D22D 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /

$0D:D27F D0 DC        BNE $D25D                       ; /
$0D:D281 60           RTS                             ; Return

; This calls the correct code for the object if the tileset is T:3 in LM (underground)

;;; $D990: Underground object dispatcher ;;;
;; Calls the draw routine for object [$5A] in tilesets using the Underground object set (LM tileset type 3).
;; Index = [$5A] - 1 into the pointer table at $0DD99A.
$0D:D990 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; 8-bit A and X/Y
$0D:D992 A6 5A        LDX $5A                         ; \
$0D:D994 CA           DEX                             ; / X = [$5A] - 1: object number as table index (object 0 never occurs)
$0D:D995 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:D996 22 FA 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtrLong            ; / Dispatch to the Underground draw routine for this object


;;; $D99A: Pointer: object $01 (water, blue) (PtrsLong0DD99A) ;;;
;; Pointer table (3-byte entries) indexed by object number - 1: Underground tileset object draw routines.
;;     Objects $22-$2D are unused; $2E-$33 are generic slots; all share $0DB3E3.
$0D:D99A C3 A8 0D     .dw $A8C3 .db :$CODE_0DA8C3     ; Object $01: Water (Blue)

;;; $D99D: Pointer: object $02 (Invisible coin blocks) (PtrsLong0DD99D) ;;;

;;; $DA68: Object: canvas tiles 1-7 ;;;
;; Writes one canvas tile Map16 $07D + ([$59] - $75) at the position.
$0D:DA68 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57]: object position
$0D:DA6A A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:DA6C 38           SEC                             ; } X = [$59] - $75: canvas tile index
$0D:DA6D E9 75        SBC.B #$75                      ; |
$0D:DA6F AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:DA70 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:DA73 BF 61 DA 0D  LDA.L $DA61,X                   ; } Page 0 / low byte from the canvas table
$0D:DA77 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:DA79 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $DA80: Object: bit of canvas 2-4 ;;;
;; Writes a top and bottom tile of canvas piece [$59] - $7C.
$0D:DA80 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57]: object position
$0D:DA82 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:DA84 38           SEC                             ; } X = [$59] - $7C: piece index
$0D:DA85 E9 7C        SBC.B #$7C                      ; |
$0D:DA87 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:DA88 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:DA8B BF 7A DA 0D  LDA.L $DA7A,X                   ; } Page 0 / top tile from table

$0D:DA91 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:DA94 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:DA97 BF 7D DA 0D  LDA.L $DA7D,X                   ; } Page 0 / bottom tile from table

$0D:DA9D 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Torpedo launcher

;;; $DA9E..DAA0: Table: torpedo launcher tiles ;;;

$0D:DAA0              .db $68,$69                     ; Torpedo launcher bottom row tiles: Map16 $168, $169


;;; $DAA2: Object: torpedo launcher ;;;
;; Draws a 2x2 torpedo launcher from Map16 $166-$169 on page 1.
$0D:DAA2 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57]: object position
$0D:DAA4 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: tile index
$0D:DAA6 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the buffer pointer
$0D:DAA9 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:DAAC BF 9E DA 0D  LDA.L $DA9E,X                   ; } Page 1 / launcher tile from table, advance one column
$0D:DAB0 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:DAB3 E8           INX                             ; Next tile
$0D:DAB4 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:DAB5 29 01        AND.B #$01                      ; } Repeat for the second tile of the row
$0D:DAB7 D0 F0        BNE $DAA9                       ; /
$0D:DAB9 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the pointer to the left
$0D:DABC 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:DABF E0 04        CPX.B #$04                      ; \
$0D:DAC1 D0 E6        BNE $DAA9                       ; / Loop until all 4 tiles are placed
$0D:DAC3 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Right facing mud/lava

;;; $DAC4..DAC6: Table: right facing mud/lava tiles ;;;

$0D:DAC6              .db $5B,$5B                     ; Plain tiles: Map16 $15B, $15B


;;; $DAC8: Objects: right facing mud/lava, slope dispatch ;;;
;; Right facing mud/lava: a column of [$59] >> 4 + 1 tiles. Then the mud/lava slope dispatcher on [$59] & 3
;;     (JSL ExecutePtrLong).
$0D:DAC8 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57]: object position
$0D:DACA A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:DACC 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } X = [$59] & $0F: type (0 = with top, 1 = without)
$0D:DACE AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:DACF A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:DAD1 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:DAD2 4A           LSR                             ; } [$00] = [$59] >> 4: height
$0D:DAD3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:DAD4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:DAD5 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:DAD7 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:DADA BF C4 DA 0D  LDA.L $DAC4,X                   ; / Page 1 / top tile from table by type
$0D:DADE 4C E8 DA     JMP.W $DAE8                     ; Skip to the write

$0D:DAE1 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:DAE4 BF C6 DA 0D  LDA.L $DAC6,X                   ; } Page 1 / middle tile from table by type
$0D:DAE8 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; Store the tile low byte
$0D:DAEA 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:DAED C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:DAEF 10 F0        BPL $DAE1                       ; / Loop for the remaining rows
$0D:DAF1 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Mud/lava slopes
$0D:DAF2 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:DAF4 29 03        AND.B #$03                      ; } Dispatch on [$59] & 3: slope type
$0D:DAF6 22 FA 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtrLong            ; /


;;; $DAFA: Mud/lava slopes, mud/lava blocks, upside down ledge (PtrsLong0DDAFA) ;;;
;; Pointer table for the four slope types, followed by their draw routines (normal and steep, left and right),
;;     the plain
;; mud/lava rectangle (with or without top) and the upside down ledge. Slope routines draw growing lines,
;;     using Map16 $1D2-$1D7 edges and $1FF fill.
$0D:DAFA 06 DB 0D     .dw $DB06 .db :$CODE_0DDB06     ; Normal left mud/lava slope
$0D:DAFD 8F DB 0D     .dw $DB8F .db :$CODE_0DDB8F     ; Steep left mud/lava slope
$0D:DB00 02 DC 0D     .dw $DC02 .db :$ADDR_0DDC02     ; Normal right mud/lava slope
$0D:DB03 61 DC 0D     .dw $DC61 .db :$CODE_0DDC61     ; Steep right mud/lava slope

$0D:DB06 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57]: object position
$0D:DB08 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0D:DB0A 85 02        STA $02                         ; } First line width = 1; [$02] = [$00] = 1
$0D:DB0C 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:DB0E 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the buffer pointer
$0D:DB11 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:DB13 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:DB14 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:DB15 4A           LSR                             ; } [$00] = ([$59] >> 4) + 1: number of lines
$0D:DB16 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:DB17 85 00        STA $00                         ; |
$0D:DB19 E6 00        INC $00                         ; /
$0D:DB1B A6 02        LDX $02                         ; X = line width counter
$0D:DB1D 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:DB20 A9 D2        LDA.B #$D2                      ; } Page 1 / tile $1D2: upper-left of the slope surface
$0D:DB22 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:DB25 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:DB28 A9 D3        LDA.B #$D3                      ; } Page 1 / tile $1D3: upper-right of the slope surface
$0D:DB2A 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:DB2D CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:DB2E CA           DEX                             ; } X -= 2; if negative, line has no fill
$0D:DB2F 30 1F        BMI $DB50                       ; /
$0D:DB31 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:DB34 A9 FB        LDA.B #$FB                      ; } Page 1 / tile $1FB: bottom-left of the slope
$0D:DB36 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:DB39 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:DB3C A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; } Page 1 / tile $1FF: bottom-right (plain fill)
$0D:DB3E 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:DB41 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:DB42 4C 4D DB     JMP.W $DB4D                     ; / X -= 1 and jump into the fill loop

$0D:DB45 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:DB48 A9 FF        LDA.B #$FF                      ; } Page 1 / tile $1FF: plain-color fill
$0D:DB4A 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:DB4D CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:DB4E 10 F5        BPL $DB45                       ; / Loop for the remaining fill tiles
$0D:DB50 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the pointer to the line start

;;; $DEDC..DF12: Canvass tile rows and screen pointers (7E) ;;;
;; Tile rows for the 8 hard-coded canvasses, their positions in screen 0, and the 16 per-screen pointers into

;;; $DF3A: Object: multiple canvasses (hardcoded position) ;;;
;; Draws the canvass strip layout of screen 0 (five rows of tile $161 and 8 canvasses at fixed positions from
;;     the tables above),
;; then copies screen 0's low and high Map16 bytes to screens 1..[$59] with MVN. Parameters: [$59] & $0F:
;;     number of screens to fill.
$0D:DF3A A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:DF3C 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } [$59] &= $0F: number of screens to fill (height bits removed)
$0D:DF3E 85 59        STA $59                         ; /
$0D:DF40 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the start-of-row pointer
$0D:DF43 A0 50        LDY.B #$50                      ; \
$0D:DF45 84 57        STY $57                         ; / Position [$57] = $50 (row 5 of screen 0)
$0D:DF47 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$0D:DF49 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $0F: row width - 1
$0D:DF4B A9 04        LDA.B #$04                      ; \
$0D:DF4D 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = 4: five rows of this tile
$0D:DF4F A6 00        LDX $00                         ; X = row width counter
$0D:DF51 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:DF54 A9 61        LDA.B #$61                      ; } Write tile $161 (page 1) and advance
$0D:DF56 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:DF59 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:DF5A 10 F5        BPL $DF51                       ; / Repeat for 16 tiles
$0D:DF5C 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:DF5F A5 57        LDA $57                         ; \

$0D:DF62 69 40        ADC.B #$40                      ; |
$0D:DF64 85 57        STA $57                         ; |
$0D:DF66 A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:DF67 90 03        BCC $DF6C                       ; } Move pointer down 4 rows ([$57] += $40, carry into screen page)
$0D:DF69 20 87 A9     JSR.W $A987                     ; /
$0D:DF6C C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:DF6E 10 DF        BPL $DF4F                       ; / Repeat for 5 rows (rows spaced 4 apart)
$0D:DF70 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$0D:DF72 85 6B        STA $6B                         ; |
$0D:DF74 85 04        STA $04                         ; } Pointer low bytes [$6B], [$04], [$6E] = 0 (the canvass table supplies the rest)
$0D:DF76 85 6E        STA $6E                         ; /
$0D:DF78 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$0D:DF7A 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Canvass index [$00] = 0
$0D:DF7C A9 07        LDA.B #$07                      ; \
$0D:DF7E 85 03        STA $03                         ; / [$03] = 7: draw 8 canvasses
$0D:DF80 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:DF82 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = 2: three middle rows
$0D:DF84 A6 00        LDX $00                         ; \
$0D:DF86 BF EA DE 0D  LDA.L $DEEA,X                   ; |
$0D:DF8A 85 57        STA $57                         ; |
$0D:DF8C A8           TAY                             ; |
$0D:DF8D BF F2 DE 0D  LDA.L $DEF2,X                   ; |
$0D:DF91 85 6C        STA $6C                         ; |
$0D:DF93 85 05        STA $05                         ; } X = canvass index; position [$57]/Y and pointer high bytes [$6C],[$05],[$6F] from the tables
$0D:DF95 85 6F        STA $6F                         ; /
$0D:DF97 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$0D:DF99 85 02        STA $02                         ; / Top row width - 1 = 3
$0D:DF9B A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into the tile table
$0D:DF9D 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:DFA0 BF DC DE 0D  LDA.L $DEDC,X                   ; |
$0D:DFA4 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |
$0D:DFA7 E8           INX                             ; |

$0D:DFAA 10 F1        BPL $DF9D                       ; /
$0D:DFAC 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:DFAF 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:DFB2 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:DFB5 BF DC DE 0D  LDA.L $DEDC,X                   ; |
$0D:DFB9 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |

$0D:DFD4 10 DC        BPL $DFB2                       ; /
$0D:DFD6 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:DFD7 E8           INX                             ; } X += 3: advance to the bottom row tiles
$0D:DFD8 E8           INX                             ; /
$0D:DFD9 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \

$0D:DFDD 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:DFE0 BF DC DE 0D  LDA.L $DEDC,X                   ; |
$0D:DFE4 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |
$0D:DFE7 E8           INX                             ; |
$0D:DFE8 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; } Write the 4 bottom row tiles (page 1)
$0D:DFEA 10 F1        BPL $DFDD                       ; /
$0D:DFEC 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:DFEF A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:DFF1 85 02        STA $02                         ; / Last row width - 1 = 2
$0D:DFF3 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:DFF6 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:DFF9 BF DC DE 0D  LDA.L $DEDC,X                   ; |
$0D:DFFD 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |

$0D:E001 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; } Write the last row: 3 tiles of $076 (page 0)
$0D:E003 10 F1        BPL $DFF6                       ; /
$0D:E005 C6 03        DEC $03                         ; \
$0D:E007 30 05        BMI $E00E                       ; / Count canvasses; done when [$03] < 0
$0D:E009 E6 00        INC $00                         ; Next canvass index
$0D:E00B 4C 80 DF     JMP.W $DF80                     ; Draw the next canvass

$0D:E00E A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; \
$0D:E010 85 08        STA $08                         ; / First screen to copy to = 1
$0D:E012 A9 00        LDA.B #$00                      ; \
$0D:E014 85 09        STA $09                         ; / High byte of the screen number = 0
$0D:E016 C2 30        REP #$30                        ; 16-bit A, X, Y
$0D:E018 A5 08        LDA $08                         ; \
$0D:E01A 0A           ASL                             ; } X = screen number * 2
$0D:E01B AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:E01C BF FA DE 0D  LDA.L $DEFA,X                   ; \
$0D:E020 85 04        STA $04                         ; / [$04] = this screen's low-byte buffer ($7E:xxxx) from $DEFA
$0D:E022 BF 1A DF 0D  LDA.L $DF1A,X                   ; \
$0D:E026 85 06        STA $06                         ; / [$06] = this screen's high-byte buffer ($7F:xxxx) from $DF1A
$0D:E028 A9 B0 01     LDA.W #$01B0                    ; \
$0D:E02B 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $01B0: bytes in one screen
$0D:E02D A9 00 C8     LDA.W #$C800                    ; \
$0D:E030 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = $C800: source = screen 0
$0D:E032 8B           PHB                             ; Save the data bank (MVN changes it)
$0D:E033 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:E035 A6 02        LDX $02                         ; } A = count, X = source, Y = destination
$0D:E037 A4 04        LDY $04                         ; /
$0D:E039 54 7E 7E     MVN $7E,$7E                     ; Copy screen 0 low bytes to this screen ($7E:C800 -> $7E:[$04])
$0D:E03C AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank
$0D:E03D A9 B0 01     LDA.W #$01B0                    ; \
$0D:E040 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = $01B0: bytes in one screen
$0D:E042 A9 00 C8     LDA.W #$C800                    ; \
$0D:E045 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = $C800: source = screen 0
$0D:E047 8B           PHB                             ; Save the data bank
$0D:E048 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:E04A A6 02        LDX $02                         ; } A = count, X = source, Y = destination
$0D:E04C A4 06        LDY $06                         ; /
$0D:E04E 54 7F 7F     MVN $7F,$7F                     ; Copy screen 0 high bytes to this screen ($7F:C800 -> $7F:[$06])
$0D:E051 AB           PLB                             ; Restore the data bank

$0D:E054 C6 59        DEC $59                         ; \

$0D:E058 E6 08        INC $08                         ; Next screen number
$0D:E05A 4C 16 E0     JMP.W $E016                     ; Copy the next screen

$0D:E05D 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $E0AE: Object: canvass 1-4 ;;;
;; Draws one 4-wide, 6-row canvass from the tables above; the extended object number $71-$74 selects the
;;     layout.
;; Parameters: [$57]: position, [$59]: object number.
$0D:E0AE A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] (object position)
$0D:E0B0 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:E0B2 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:E0B3 E9 71        SBC.B #$71                      ; } X = [$59] - $71: canvass number 0-3 (extended objects $71-$74)
$0D:E0B5 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:E0B6 BF AA E0 0D  LDA.L $E0AA,X                   ; \
$0D:E0BA AA           TAX                             ; / X = X * $13: offset of that canvass in the tile tables
$0D:E0BB 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the start-of-row pointer
$0D:E0BE A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:E0C0 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$01] = 2: three middle rows in this loop
$0D:E0C2 A9 03        LDA.B #$03                      ; \
$0D:E0C4 85 02        STA $02                         ; / Top row width - 1 = 3
$0D:E0C6 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:E0C9 BF 5E E0 0D  LDA.L $E05E,X                   ; |
$0D:E0CD 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |
$0D:E0D0 E8           INX                             ; |
$0D:E0D1 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; } Write the 4 top row tiles (page 1) from $E05E,X
$0D:E0D3 10 F1        BPL $E0C6                       ; /
$0D:E0D5 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; \
$0D:E0D8 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; / Restore the pointer and move down one row
$0D:E0DB A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:E0DD 85 02        STA $02                         ; / Middle row width - 1 = 2
$0D:E0DF 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:E0E2 BF 5E E0 0D  LDA.L $E05E,X                   ; |
$0D:E0E6 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |
$0D:E0E9 E8           INX                             ; |
$0D:E0EA C6 02        DEC $02                         ; } Write 3 middle row tiles (page 0), advancing X
$0D:E0EC 10 F1        BPL $E0DF                       ; /
$0D:E0EE 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; \
$0D:E0F1 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; |
$0D:E0F4 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; } Restore the pointer, move down a row; repeat for 3 middle rows
$0D:E0F6 10 E3        BPL $E0DB                       ; /
$0D:E0F8 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:E0FA 85 02        STA $02                         ; / Fourth middle row width - 1 = 2
$0D:E0FC 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:E0FF BF 5E E0 0D  LDA.L $E05E,X                   ; |
$0D:E103 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |
$0D:E106 E8           INX                             ; |
$0D:E107 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; } Write 3 tiles of the fourth middle row (page 0)
$0D:E109 10 F1        BPL $E0FC                       ; /
$0D:E10B 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:E10E A9 5F        LDA.B #$5F                      ; } Write tile $15F (page 1) at the right end of that row
$0D:E110 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:E112 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:E115 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:E117 85 02        STA $02                         ; / Last row width - 1 = 2
$0D:E119 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:E11C 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:E11F BF 5E E0 0D  LDA.L $E05E,X                   ; |
$0D:E123 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; |
$0D:E126 E8           INX                             ; |
$0D:E127 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; } Write the 3 last row tiles (page 0)
$0D:E129 10 F1        BPL $E11C                       ; /
$0D:E12B 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Four-sided edge ground square

;;; $E12C..E132: Table: four-sided ground square tiles ;;;
;; 3 rows (top, middle, bottom) of left, middle and right tiles, page 1.
$0D:E12C              .db $45,$50,$4D                 ; Left tiles (page 1): $145 top, $150 middle, $14D bottom
$0D:E12F              .db $00,$F0,$4E                 ; Middle tiles (page 1): $100 top, $1F0 middle, $14E bottom
$0D:E132              .db $48,$51,$4F                 ; Right tiles (page 1): $148 top, $151 middle, $14F bottom


;;; $E135: Object: four-sided edge ground square ;;;
;; Rectangle with a left, middle and right tile per row and separate top, middle and bottom row tiles.
;; Parameters: [$57]: position, [$59] & $0F: width, [$59] >> 4: height (rows = height + 1).
$0D:E135 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] (object position)
$0D:E137 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:E139 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } [$00] = [$59] & $0F: width
$0D:E13B 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:E13D A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:E13F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:E140 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:E141 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:E142 4A           LSR                             ; } [$01] = [$59] >> 4: height
$0D:E143 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$0D:E145 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the start-of-row pointer
$0D:E148 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: top row table index
$0D:E14A A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:E14C 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = width: middle tiles in the row
$0D:E14E 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:E151 BF 2C E1 0D  LDA.L $E12C,X                   ; } Write the left tile (page 1) and advance
$0D:E155 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:E158 4C 65 E1     JMP.W $E165                     ; Skip the first middle tile check

$0D:E15B 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:E15E BF 2F E1 0D  LDA.L $E12F,X                   ; } Write a middle tile (page 1) and advance
$0D:E162 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:E165 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$0D:E167 D0 F2        BNE $E15B                       ; / Repeat for the width of the row
$0D:E169 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:E16C BF 32 E1 0D  LDA.L $E132,X                   ; } Write the right tile (page 1)
$0D:E170 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:E172 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Restore the start-of-row pointer
$0D:E175 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:E178 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: middle row table index
$0D:E17A C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:E17C 30 07        BMI $E185                       ; / Count rows; return when [$01] < 0
$0D:E17E D0 02        BNE $E182                       ; \
$0D:E180 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; / Last row? then X = 2: bottom row table index
$0D:E182 4C 4A E1     JMP.W $E14A                     ; Draw the next row

$0D:E185 60           RTS                             ; Return

; This calls the correct code for the object if the tileset is T:4 in LM (ghost house or switch palace)

;;; $E890: Dispatch: objects for tileset 4 (ghost house) ;;;
;; Calls the routine for object [$5A] through ExecutePtrLong using the table below (object 1 = first entry).
;; Used when the tileset is T:4 in Lunar Magic (ghost house or switch palace).
$0D:E890 E2 30        SEP #$30                        ; 8-bit A, X, Y
$0D:E892 A6 5A        LDX $5A                         ; \
$0D:E894 CA           DEX                             ; } A = [$5A] - 1: object number (never 0) as pointer table index
$0D:E895 8A           TXA                             ; /
$0D:E896 22 FA 86 00  JSL.L ExecutePtrLong            ; Run the object's routine (pointer table below)

;;; $E9AA: Object: ghost house clock and beams (3x3) ;;;
;; Draws a 3x3 piece from the table above. Parameters: [$57]: position, [$59]: extended object $61-$63.
$0D:E9AA A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = [$57] (object position)

$0D:E9B3 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0D:E9B4 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0D:E9B5 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0D:E9B6 18           CLC                             ; |
$0D:E9B7 65 00        ADC $00                         ; } X = ([$59] - $61) * 9: offset of this 3x3 piece (clock, beam TL-BR, beam TR-BL)
$0D:E9B9 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:E9BA A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:E9BC 85 00        STA $00                         ; } [$00] = [$01] = 2: width and height - 1
$0D:E9BE 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$0D:E9C0 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the start-of-row pointer
$0D:E9C3 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \

$0D:E9CD E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:E9CE C6 00        DEC $00                         ; } Next tile; repeat for the row

$0D:E9D2 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; \
$0D:E9D5 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; / Restore the pointer and move down one row
$0D:E9D8 A9 02        LDA.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:E9DA 85 00        STA $00                         ; / Row width - 1 = 2
$0D:E9DC C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:E9DE 10 E3        BPL $E9C3                       ; / Repeat for 3 rows

;;; $EC33: Draw Yoshi's house, switch palace edge ;;;
;; Two level object draw routines. $0DEC33 (Yoshi's house): writes a fixed 16x10 block of Map16 tiles from
;;     $EB93 (row by row, page 0).
;; $0DEC5C (switch palace right/bottom edge): writes the single Map16 tile $110 (page 1).
;; Parameters: [$57]: position in the Map16 buffer, [$59]: size byte (width/height nibbles), [$6B]/[$6E]:
;;     Map16 buffer pointers.
$0D:EC33 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position in the Map16 screen buffer ([$57])
$0D:EC35 A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into the house tile table $EB93
$0D:EC37 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; \
$0D:EC39 85 00        STA $00                         ; / [$00] = 15: tiles to write before the last one of a row
$0D:EC3B 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:EC3E BF 93 EB 0D  LDA.L $EB93,X                   ; } Page 0; write tile [DATA_0DEB93+X] and move right
$0D:EC42 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:EC45 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:EC46 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; } X++; repeat for 15 tiles
$0D:EC48 D0 F1        BNE $EC3B                       ; /
$0D:EC4A 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:EC4D BF 93 EB 0D  LDA.L $EB93,X                   ; } Page 0; write the 16th tile of the row (no advance)
$0D:EC51 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:EC53 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:EC54 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; / X++; move down one row (Y reloaded from [$57] + $10)
$0D:EC57 E0 A0        CPX.B #$A0                      ; \
$0D:EC59 D0 DC        BNE $EC37                       ; / Repeat until X = $A0: 10 rows of 16 tiles
$0D:EC5B 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Switch palace right and bottom edge tile
$0D:EC5C A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position in the Map16 screen buffer ([$57])
$0D:EC5E 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Map16 page 1
$0D:EC61 A9 10        LDA.B #$10                      ; \
$0D:EC63 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; / Write Map16 tile $110 at the position
$0D:EC65 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $EC68: Draw water weed object ;;;
;; Writes a 1x2 stack of tiles from $EC66 (page 0), moving down a row after each.
;; Parameters: [$57]: position in the Map16 buffer, [$59]: size byte (width/height nibbles), [$6B]/[$6E]:
;;     Map16 buffer pointers.
$0D:EC68 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position in the Map16 screen buffer ([$57])
$0D:EC6A A2 00        LDX.B #$00                      ; X = 0: index into the weed tiles
$0D:EC6C 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:EC6F BF 66 EC 0D  LDA.L $EC66,X                   ; } Page 0; write tile [DATA_0DEC66+X] at the position
$0D:EC73 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:EC75 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; \
$0D:EC78 E8           INX                             ; / Move down one row; X++
$0D:EC79 E0 02        CPX.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:EC7B D0 EF        BNE $EC6C                       ; / Repeat for 2 tiles (height 2)
$0D:EC7D 60           RTS                             ; Return


;The four switches in the switch palaces

;;; $EC7E..EC8C: Table: switch Map16 tiles ;;;
;; Four switches (green, yellow, blue, red), 4 tiles each: top row left/right, then bottom row left/right
;;     (Map16 $0EC-$0FB, page 0).
$0D:EC7E              .db $EC,$ED                     ; Green switch top row: Map16 $0EC,$0ED
$0D:EC80              .db $EE,$EF                     ; Green switch bottom row: $0EE,$0EF

$0D:EC82              .db $F0,$F1                     ; Yellow switch top row: $0F0,$0F1
$0D:EC84              .db $F2,$F3                     ; Yellow switch bottom row: $0F2,$0F3

$0D:EC86              .db $F4,$F5                     ; Blue switch top row: $0F4,$0F5
$0D:EC88              .db $F6,$F7                     ; Blue switch bottom row: $0F6,$0F7

$0D:EC8A              .db $F8,$F9                     ; Red switch top row: $0F8,$0F9
$0D:EC8C              .db $FA,$FB                     ; Red switch bottom row: $0FA,$0FB


;;; $EC8E: Draw switch palace switch, ghost house window ;;;
;; $0DEC8E: draws the 2x2 switch for color X = object number - $8A, unless the matching switch palace flag
;;     [$1F27+X] is already set.
;; $0DECC1 (ghost house window): sets X = 8 and jumps into the ghost house cobweb code at $0DE9F5, which draws
;;     the 2x2 window tiles $0FC-$0FF.
;; Parameters: [$57]: position in the Map16 buffer, [$59]: size byte (width/height nibbles), [$6B]/[$6E]:
;;     Map16 buffer pointers.
$0D:EC8E A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position in the Map16 screen buffer ([$57])
$0D:EC90 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:EC92 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:EC93 E9 8A        SBC.B #$8A                      ; } X = object number - $8A (switch color index 0-3)
$0D:EC95 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:EC96 BF 27 1F 00  LDA.L $001F27,X                 ; \
$0D:EC9A D0 24        BNE $ECC0                       ; / If switch palace flag [$1F27+X] is set (already hit) draw nothing
$0D:EC9C 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:EC9D 0A           ASL                             ; |
$0D:EC9E 0A           ASL                             ; } X *= 4: offset into the switch tile table
$0D:EC9F AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:ECA0 A9 01        LDA.B #$01                      ; A = 1: 2x2 tiles
$0D:ECA2 85 00        STA $00                         ; \
$0D:ECA4 85 01        STA $01                         ; / [$00] = [$01] = 1: width and height minus one
$0D:ECA6 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:ECA8 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = row width counter
$0D:ECAA 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:ECAD BF 7E EC 0D  LDA.L $EC7E,X                   ; } Page 0; write tile [DATA_0DEC7E+X] and move right
$0D:ECB1 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /
$0D:ECB4 E8           INX                             ; \
$0D:ECB5 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; } X++; repeat for 2 tiles per row
$0D:ECB7 10 F1        BPL $ECAA                       ; /
$0D:ECB9 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:ECBC C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:ECBE 10 E6        BPL $ECA6                       ; / Repeat for 2 rows
$0D:ECC0 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Ghost house window
$0D:ECC1 A2 08        LDX.B #$08                      ; X = 8: offset of the ghost house window tiles ($0FC-$0FF) in the cobweb table
$0D:ECC3 4C F5 E9     JMP.W $E9F5                     ; Jump into the ghost house cobweb routine to draw a 2x2 block


;Grey bricks background and wooden blocks

;;; $ECC6..ECC6: Table: background block Map16 tiles ;;;
;; Indexed by type: $092 grey bricks background, $15E wooden block (page 1 via the CPX #1 check), $082 log
;;     background.
$0D:ECC6              .db $92,$5E,$82                 ; Tile by type: $092 grey bricks bg, $15E wooden block (page 1), $082 log bg


;;; $ECC9: Draw grey bricks, wooden blocks, log bg ;;;
;; Fills a (width+1) x (height+1) rectangle with one Map16 tile chosen by type X = object number - $34 (also
;;     entered at $0DECCE from the log background object with X = 2).
;; Type 1 (wooden blocks) writes on Map16 page 1, the others on page 0.
;; Parameters: [$57]: position in the Map16 buffer, [$59]: size byte (width/height nibbles), [$6B]/[$6E]:
;;     Map16 buffer pointers.
$0D:ECC9 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:ECCA 38           SEC                             ; |
$0D:ECCB E9 34        SBC.B #$34                      ; } X = object number - $34: type 0 grey bricks, 1 wooden blocks
$0D:ECCD AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:ECCE A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position in the Map16 screen buffer ([$57])
$0D:ECD0 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:ECD2 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; |
$0D:ECD4 85 00        STA $00                         ; } [$00] = [$02] = width, low nibble of [$59]
$0D:ECD6 85 02        STA $02                         ; /
$0D:ECD8 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:ECDA 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:ECDB 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:ECDC 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:ECDD 4A           LSR                             ; } [$01] = height, high nibble of [$59]
$0D:ECDE 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$0D:ECE0 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the row start pointer in [$04]-[$05]
$0D:ECE3 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:ECE6 E0 01        CPX.B #$01                      ; |
$0D:ECE8 D0 03        BNE $ECED                       ; } Page 0, or page 1 for type 1 (wooden blocks)
$0D:ECEA 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; /
$0D:ECED BF C6 EC 0D  LDA.L $ECC6,X                   ; \
$0D:ECF1 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Write tile [DATA_0DECC6+X] and move right
$0D:ECF4 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$0D:ECF6 A5 02        LDA $02                         ; } [$02]--; repeat for width + 1 tiles
$0D:ECF8 10 E9        BPL $ECE3                       ; /
$0D:ECFA 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Reload the row start pointer
$0D:ECFD 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:ED00 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:ED02 85 02        STA $02                         ; / Reload the row width counter
$0D:ED04 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:ED06 10 DB        BPL $ECE3                       ; / Repeat for height + 1 rows
$0D:ED08 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $ED09..ED0F: Table: log and hand rail Map16 tiles ;;;
;; Three 3-byte rows (left, middle, right tile) each indexed by type 0-2: $082 log background, $089/$08A/$08B
;;     hand rail, $088.
$0D:ED09              .db $82,$89,$88                 ; Left tile by type: $082, $089, $088 (page 0)
$0D:ED0C              .db $82,$8A,$88                 ; Middle tile by type: $082, $08A, $088
$0D:ED0F              .db $82,$8B,$88                 ; Right tile by type: $082, $08B, $088


;;; $ED12: Draw horizontal log bg, wood ledge ;;;
;; $0DED12: one row of tiles, left + (width) middle + right, taken from the tables at $ED09 by type
;;     (high nibble).
;; $0DED43 (wood ledge without column): one row, left $10A, middle $10B, right $10C (page 1). $0DED4A is also
;;     called by the column ledge routine.
;; Parameters: [$57]: position in the Map16 buffer, [$59]: size byte (width/height nibbles), [$6B]/[$6E]:
;;     Map16 buffer pointers.
$0D:ED12 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position in the Map16 screen buffer ([$57])
$0D:ED14 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:ED16 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } [$00] = width, low nibble of the size byte [$59]
$0D:ED18 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:ED1A A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:ED1C 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:ED1D 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:ED1E 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:ED1F 4A           LSR                             ; } X = type, high nibble of [$59]

;;; $ED6B: Draw vertical log background ;;;
;; Writes a vertical column of (height+1) tiles: the top tile and then middle tiles from the type tables
;;     $ED65/$ED68.
;; Parameters: [$57]: position in the Map16 buffer, [$59]: size byte (width/height nibbles), [$6B]/[$6E]:
;;     Map16 buffer pointers.
$0D:ED6B A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position in the Map16 screen buffer ([$57])
$0D:ED6D A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:ED6F 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:ED70 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:ED71 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:ED72 4A           LSR                             ; } [$00] = height, high nibble of [$59]
$0D:ED73 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:ED75 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:ED77 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } X = type, low nibble of [$59]
$0D:ED79 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:ED7A 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:ED7D BF 65 ED 0D  LDA.L $ED65,X                   ; } Page 0; top tile [DATA_0DED65+X], then go store it
$0D:ED81 4C 8B ED     JMP.W $ED8B                     ; /

$0D:ED84 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:ED87 BF 68 ED 0D  LDA.L $ED68,X                   ; / Page 0; middle tile [DATA_0DED68+X]
$0D:ED8B 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; Store the tile (vertical object: no advance right)
$0D:ED8D 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:ED90 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:ED92 10 F0        BPL $ED84                       ; / Repeat for height + 1 tiles
$0D:ED94 60           RTS                             ; Return

;;; $ED99: Draw edges, ledges, cloud, grass ledge 2 ;;;
;; Several object routines: vertical brick edges/spike columns ($0DED99), the bonus room wood ledge ($0DEDB9),
;;     the four switch palace pieces (upside down ledge $0DEDDB,
;; ledge $0DEE17, right facing edge $0DEE52, left facing edge $0DEE89), wood ledge on column ($0DEEC0), cloud
;;     ledge ($0DEF45) and grass ledge 2 ($0DEF67).
;; The column ledge draws the ledge row, then (height) tall $078/$079 log columns every 4 tiles beneath it,
;;     one column per [$00] + 1.
;; Parameters: [$57]: position in the Map16 buffer, [$59]: size byte (width/height nibbles), [$6B]/[$6E]:
;;     Map16 buffer pointers.

$0D:EDA3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:EDA4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:EDA5 4A           LSR                             ; } [$00] = height, high nibble of [$59]
$0D:EDA6 85 00        STA $00                         ; /

$0D:EDB6 10 F0        BPL $EDA8                       ; / Repeat for height + 1 tiles

$0D:EF98 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; /

$0D:EF9C 10 F5        BPL $EF93                       ; / Repeat for width + 1 tiles
$0D:EF9E 4C 87 EF     JMP.W $EF87                     ; Next row

$0D:EFA1 60           RTS                             ; Return


;Wooden crate

;;; $EFA2..EFA6: Table: wooden crate Map16 tiles ;;;
;; Interior row tiles: left ($163,$165 page 1), middle ($0C7,$0C8 page 0) and right ($164,$16A page 1); the
;;     row used alternates per line.
$0D:EFA2              .db $63,$65                     ; Left tiles for odd/even rows (page 1): $163, $165
$0D:EFA4              .db $C7,$C8                     ; Middle tiles (page 0): $0C7, $0C8 (top and bottom rows are separate)
$0D:EFA6              .db $64,$6A                     ; Right tiles (page 1): $164, $16A


;;; $EFA8: Draw wooden crate, grass ledge 1, log bg ;;;
;; $0DEFA8: wooden crate, top row $161/$10D/$162, interior rows alternating between two patterns, bottom row
;;     $16B/$16C/$16D (page 1 mostly).
;; $0DF02B: grass ledge 1, a $10F top row (page 1) over $0EA fill rows. $0DF066: log background, enters the
;;     rectangle fill with X = 2.
;; Quirk: the crate and ledge code uses BNE as an always-taken branch after loading a non-zero tile.
;; Parameters: [$57]: position in the Map16 buffer, [$59]: size byte (width/height nibbles), [$6B]/[$6E]:
;;     Map16 buffer pointers.
$0D:EFA8 A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position in the Map16 screen buffer ([$57])
$0D:EFAA A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:EFAC 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } [$00] = width, low nibble of the size byte [$59]
$0D:EFAE 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:EFB0 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:EFB2 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:EFB3 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:EFB4 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:EFB5 4A           LSR                             ; } [$01] = height, high nibble of [$59]
$0D:EFB6 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$0D:EFB8 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the row start pointer
$0D:EFBB A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:EFBD 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = width counter
$0D:EFBF 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:EFC2 A9 61        LDA.B #$61                      ; } Page 1; top left tile $161, skip the middle-tile load
$0D:EFC4 D0 05        BNE $EFCB                       ; /
$0D:EFC6 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:EFC9 A9 0D        LDA.B #$0D                      ; / Page 1; upper middle tile $10D
$0D:EFCB 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; Write the tile and move right
$0D:EFCE C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$0D:EFD0 D0 F4        BNE $EFC6                       ; / Repeat for width middle tiles
$0D:EFD2 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:EFD5 A9 62        LDA.B #$62                      ; } Page 1; upper right tile $162
$0D:EFD7 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:EFD9 A2 01        LDX.B #$01                      ; X = 1: index of the first interior row pattern
$0D:EFDB 4C FE EF     JMP.W $EFFE                     ; Go to the end-of-row code

$0D:EFDE 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:EFE1 BF A2 EF 0D  LDA.L $EFA2,X                   ; } Page 1; left tile [DATA_0DEFA2+X] (always non-zero: skip next load)
$0D:EFE5 D0 07        BNE $EFEE                       ; /
$0D:EFE7 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer0080E7      ; \
$0D:EFEA BF A4 EF 0D  LDA.L $EFA4,X                   ; / Page 0; middle tile [DATA_0DEFA4+X]
$0D:EFEE 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; Write the tile and move right
$0D:EFF1 C6 02        DEC $02                         ; \
$0D:EFF3 D0 F2        BNE $EFE7                       ; / Repeat for width middle tiles
$0D:EFF5 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:EFF8 BF A6 EF 0D  LDA.L $EFA6,X                   ; } Page 1; right tile [DATA_0DEFA6+X], no advance
$0D:EFFC 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:EFFE 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Reload the row start pointer

$0D:F001 A5 00        LDA $00                         ; \
$0D:F003 85 02        STA $02                         ; / [$02] = width counter
$0D:F005 8A           TXA                             ; \
$0D:F006 49 01        EOR #$01                        ; } X ^= 1: alternate the interior row pattern
$0D:F008 AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:F009 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:F00C C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:F00E D0 CE        BNE $EFDE                       ; / Repeat for the interior rows
$0D:F010 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:F013 A9 6B        LDA.B #$6B                      ; } Page 1; bottom left tile $16B, skip the middle-tile load
$0D:F015 D0 05        BNE $F01A                       ; /
$0D:F017 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:F01A A9 6C        LDA.B #$6C                      ; / Page 1; bottom middle tile $16C
$0D:F01C 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; Write the tile and move right
$0D:F01F C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:F021 D0 F4        BNE $F017                       ; / Repeat for width middle tiles
$0D:F023 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:F026 A9 6D        LDA.B #$6D                      ; } Page 1; bottom right tile $16D
$0D:F028 97 6B        STA [$6B],Y                     ; /
$0D:F02A 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0D:F02B A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position in the Map16 screen buffer ([$57])
$0D:F02D A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:F02F 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } [$00] = width, low nibble of the size byte [$59]
$0D:F031 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:F033 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:F035 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:F036 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:F037 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:F038 4A           LSR                             ; } [$01] = height, high nibble of [$59]
$0D:F039 85 01        STA $01                         ; /
$0D:F03B 20 B1 A6     JSR.W $A6B1                     ; Save the row start pointer
$0D:F03E A6 00        LDX $00                         ; X = width
$0D:F040 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; \
$0D:F043 A9 0F        LDA.B #$0F                      ; / Page 1; top tile $10F
$0D:F045 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; Write the tile and move right
$0D:F048 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:F049 10 F5        BPL $F040                       ; / Repeat for width + 1 tiles
$0D:F04B 4C 5B F0     JMP.W $F05B                     ; Go to the next row

$0D:F04E A6 00        LDX $00                         ; X = width
$0D:F050 20 0D AA     JSR.W StzTo6ePointer            ; \
$0D:F053 A9 EA        LDA.B #$EA                      ; / Page 0; fill tile $0EA
$0D:F055 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; Write the tile and move right
$0D:F058 CA           DEX                             ; \
$0D:F059 10 F5        BPL $F050                       ; / Repeat for width + 1 tiles
$0D:F05B 20 BA A6     JSR.W $A6BA                     ; Reload the row start pointer
$0D:F05E 20 7D A9     JSR.W $A97D                     ; Move down one row
$0D:F061 C6 01        DEC $01                         ; \
$0D:F063 10 E9        BPL $F04E                       ; / Repeat for height rows
$0D:F065 60           RTS                             ; Return

$0D:F066 A2 02        LDX.B #$02                      ; \
$0D:F068 4C CE EC     JMP.W $ECCE                     ; / X = 2: log background type (tile $082), use the rectangle fill routine

;;; $F06C: Draw thin upward spikes ;;;
;; Writes a row of (width+1) spike tiles from $F06B on page 1. The tile index comes from the high
;;     nibble, which only works for 0.
;; Parameters: [$57]: position in the Map16 buffer, [$59]: size byte (width/height nibbles), [$6B]/[$6E]:
;;     Map16 buffer pointers.
$0D:F06C A4 57        LDY $57                         ; Y = position in the Map16 screen buffer ([$57])
$0D:F06E A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:F070 29 0F        AND.B #$0F                      ; } [$00] = width, low nibble of the size byte [$59]
$0D:F072 85 00        STA $00                         ; /
$0D:F074 A5 59        LDA $59                         ; \
$0D:F076 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:F077 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:F078 4A           LSR                             ; |
$0D:F079 4A           LSR                             ; } X = index into the tile table, high nibble of [$59] (only 0 is defined)
$0D:F07A AA           TAX                             ; /
$0D:F07B 20 08 AA     JSR.W Sta1To6ePointer           ; Map16 page 1
$0D:F07E BF 6B F0 0D  LDA.L $F06B,x                   ; \
$0D:F082 20 5B A9     JSR.W $A95B                     ; / Write tile [DATA_0DF06B+X] and move right
$0D:F085 C6 00        DEC $00                         ; \
$0D:F087 10 F2        BPL $F07B                       ; / Repeat for width + 1 tiles
$0D:F089 60           RTS                             ; Return
